    26	/-- Projective refinement followed by two operator comparisons. If the evaluated
    27	measurement has consistency defect at most `eta` with `B`, and `B` is within
    28	`deltaSelf` of `A`, which is within `deltaOrder` of `T`, the full outcome sum
    29	for `R - R T` is at most `4 eta + 4 deltaSelf + 4 deltaOrder`.
    30	This is the quantitative insertion calculation in `eq:qld-g-42/43`; `T` need
    31	not be a measurement, so it applies to either ordered product. -/
    32	theorem projective_refinement_ordered_dist_le {X Γ α ι : Type*}
    33	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
    34	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    35	    (μ : Distribution X) (R : Measurement Γ ι) (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R)
    36	    (ev : X → Γ → α) (A B : X → Measurement α ι) (T : X → α → Op ι)
    37	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (eta deltaSelf deltaOrder : ℝ)
    38	    (hpoint : consistencyDefect μ
    39	      (fun x a => (R.postprocess (ev x)).effect a) (fun x a => (B x).effect a) ψ ≤ eta)
    40	    (hself : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (B x).effect a)
    41	      (fun x a => (A x).effect a) ψ ≤ deltaSelf)
    42	    (horder : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (A x).effect a) T ψ ≤ deltaOrder) :
    43	    opFamilyDistSq μ (fun _ g => R.effect g)
    44	      (fun x g => R.effect g * T x (ev x g)) ψ ≤
    45	        4 * eta + 4 * deltaSelf + 4 * deltaOrder := by
    46	  have hlift (U V : X → α → Op ι) :
    47	      opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x g => R.effect g * U x (ev x g))
    48	        (fun x g => R.effect g * V x (ev x g)) ψ ≤ opFamilyDistSq μ U V ψ := by
    49	    unfold opFamilyDistSq
    50	    apply avgOver_mono
    51	    intro x
    52	    simpa only [mul_sub] using sum_norm_mul_funIndexed_apply_le (ev x) R.effect
    53	      (fun a => U x a - V x a) ψ (measurement_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one R)
    54	  have hinsert : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun _ g => R.effect g)
    55	      (fun x g => R.effect g * (B x).effect (ev x g)) ψ ≤ 2 * eta := by
    56	    have h := hlift (fun x a => (R.postprocess (ev x)).effect a)
    57	      (fun x a => (B x).effect a)
    58	    simp only [effect_mul_postprocess_effect_self R hR] at h
    59	    exact h.trans ((opFamilyDistSq_le_two_mul_consistencyDefect μ
    60	      (fun x => R.postprocess (ev x)) B ψ).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoint
    61	        (by norm_num)))
    62	  have htail := (hlift (fun x a => (B x).effect a) T).trans
    63	    (opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le μ (fun x a => (B x).effect a)
    64	      (fun x a => (A x).effect a) T ψ deltaSelf deltaOrder hself horder)
    65	  have h := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le μ (fun _ g => R.effect g)
    66	    (fun x g => R.effect g * (B x).effect (ev x g))
    67	    (fun x g => R.effect g * T x (ev x g)) ψ (2 * eta)
    68	    (2 * deltaSelf + 2 * deltaOrder) hinsert htail
    69	  convert h using 1
    70	  ring

    72	namespace CombinedPointsWitness

    74	/-- Both ordered estimates `eq:qld-g-42/43` for a projective global measurement
    75	on any expanded block, compared to point operators on its opposite block.
    76	The readout `ev` may in particular be evaluation of an extended polynomial.
    77	The input `eta` is the actual rounded point-comparison error, not the unrounded
    78	low-degree error. The two losses of `deltaQ` come respectively from point
    79	self-consistency and the existing ordered-product approximation. No global-pair
    80	witness or concentration estimate is assumed. -/
    81	theorem ordered_dist_le {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ}
    82	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε} (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ)
    83	    {Γ : Type*} [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
    84	    (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopposite : p1.IsOpposite p2)
    85	    (R : Measurement Γ (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    86	    (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R) (ev : ExtendedPointQuestion P → Γ → PauliScalar P)
    87	    (eta : ℝ)
    88	    (hpoint : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
    89	      (fun x a => S.place p1 ((R.postprocess (ev x)).effect a))
    90	      (fun x a => S.place p2
    91	        ((points.extendedQ p2.side x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2.1 x.2.2).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤ eta) :
    92	    (opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
    93	      (fun _ g => S.place p1 (R.effect g))
    94	      (fun x g => S.place p1 (R.effect g) * S.place p2
    95	        (∑ ab ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P =>
    96	            x.2.1 * ab.1 + x.2.2 * ab.2 = ev x g),
    97	          (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X x.1.1).effect ab.1 *
    98	            (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z x.1.2).effect ab.2)) S.psiHat ≤
    99	        4 * eta + 8 * δQ) ∧
   100	    (opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
   101	      (fun _ g => S.place p1 (R.effect g))
   102	      (fun x g => S.place p1 (R.effect g) * S.place p2
   103	        (∑ ab ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P =>
   104	            x.2.1 * ab.1 + x.2.2 * ab.2 = ev x g),
   105	          (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z x.1.2).effect ab.2 *
   106	            (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X x.1.1).effect ab.1)) S.psiHat ≤
   107	        4 * eta + 8 * δQ) := by
   108	  classical
   109	  let A (x : ExtendedPointQuestion P) := S.placedMeasurement p1
   110	    (points.extendedQ p1.side x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2.1 x.2.2)
   111	  let B (x : ExtendedPointQuestion P) := S.placedMeasurement p2
   112	    (points.extendedQ p2.side x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2.1 x.2.2)
   113	  have hpoint' : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
   114	      (fun x a => ((S.placedMeasurement p1 R).postprocess (ev x)).effect a)
   115	      (fun x a => (B x).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ eta := by
   116	    simpa only [Measurement.postprocess_effect, ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect,
   117	      ProjectiveSetting.place_finsetSum, B] using hpoint
   118	  have hself : opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
   119	      (fun x a => (B x).effect a) (fun x a => (A x).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ δQ := by
   120	    rw [opFamilyDistSq_symm]
   121	    exact (extendedQ_spec points).2.1 p1 p2 hopposite
   122	  have hbound := projective_refinement_ordered_dist_le
   123	    (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P)) (S.placedMeasurement p1 R)
   124	    (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p1 R hR) ev A B
   125	  constructor
   126	  · have h := hbound _ S.psiHat eta δQ δQ hpoint' hself
   127	      ((extendedQ_spec points).2.2.1 p1 p2 hopposite)
   128	    simpa only [ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect,
   129	      show 4 * eta + 4 * δQ + 4 * δQ = 4 * eta + 8 * δQ by ring] using h
   130	  · have h := hbound _ S.psiHat eta δQ δQ hpoint' hself
   131	      ((extendedQ_spec points).2.2.2 p1 p2 hopposite)
   132	    simpa only [ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect,
   133	      show 4 * eta + 4 * δQ + 4 * δQ = 4 * eta + 8 * δQ by ring] using h
   134

   302	/-- Formalization-only simultaneous rounding and transport for the compression
   303	step of `lem:qld-4-7`. A single pair of complete projective measurements on the
   304	original heterogeneous spaces satisfies the distance bounds and both consistency
   305	estimates for every finite question type, probability distribution, and
   306	question-dependent outcome map. Each comparison family requires only its own

   308	`‖ψ‖ = 1`, `δ ≥ 0`, and the original cross-player consistency bound; no range
   309	restriction on the comparison error or outcome-cardinality factor is imposed. -/
   310	theorem projective_rounding_preserves_postprocessed_consistency
   311	    {ιA ιB α : Type*}
   312	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   313	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

   315	    (A : Measurement α ιA) (B : Measurement α ιB) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
   316	    (hcons : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   317	      (fun _ a => heteroKron (A.effect a) 1)
   318	      (fun _ a => heteroKron 1 (B.effect a)) ψ ≤ δ) :
   319	    ∃ PA : Measurement α ιA, ∃ PB : Measurement α ιB,
   320	      Measurement.IsProjective PA ∧ Measurement.IsProjective PB ∧
   321	      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   322	        (fun _ a => heteroKron (PA.effect a) 1)
   323	        (fun _ a => heteroKron (A.effect a) 1) ψ ≤
   324	          220 * Real.rpow δ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ∧
   325	      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   326	        (fun _ a => heteroKron 1 (PB.effect a))
   327	        (fun _ a => heteroKron 1 (B.effect a)) ψ ≤
   328	          220 * Real.rpow δ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ∧
   329	      ∀ {X β : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
   330	        (μ : Distribution X), μ.IsProbability → ∀ (f : X → α → β),
   331	        (∀ (N : X → Measurement β ιB) (η : ℝ),
   332	          consistencyDefect μ
   333	            (fun x b => heteroKron ((A.postprocess (f x)).effect b) 1)
   334	            (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect b)) ψ ≤ η →
   335	          consistencyDefect μ
   336	            (fun x b => heteroKron ((PA.postprocess (f x)).effect b) 1)
   337	            (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect b)) ψ ≤
   338	              δ + Real.sqrt (220 * Real.rpow δ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
   339	                2 * Real.sqrt (δ + η)) ∧
   340	        (∀ (N : X → Measurement β ιA) (η : ℝ),
   341	          consistencyDefect μ
   342	            (fun x b => heteroKron ((N x).effect b) 1)
   343	            (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((B.postprocess (f x)).effect b)) ψ ≤ η →
   344	          consistencyDefect μ
   345	            (fun x b => heteroKron ((N x).effect b) 1)
   346	            (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((PB.postprocess (f x)).effect b)) ψ ≤
   347	              δ + Real.sqrt (220 * Real.rpow δ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
   348	                2 * Real.sqrt (δ + η)) := by

   354	  intro X β _ _ _ _ μ hμ f
   355	  exact ⟨hAtransport μ hμ f, hBtransport μ hμ f⟩

    33	/-- The completed point-pair effect is bounded by the effect of its linear
    34	combination at the actual combined evaluation. Undefined source evaluations
    35	contribute zero on the point side. The statement holds for either player's
    36	measurement without any symmetry assumption on the strategy or local spaces. -/
    37	theorem SubLineWitness.completedPoint_effect_le {params : AdmissibleParams}
    38	    {Carrier : Type*} [Fintype Carrier] [DecidableEq Carrier]
    39	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (sample : SubLineTriple params)
    40	    (hsample : sample ∈ sublines.D.support)
    41	    (polynomials : DegPoly params.toLdParams (params.m * params.d) ×
    42	      DegPoly params.toLdParams (params.m * params.d))
    43	    (point : Fin params.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)
    44	    (hpoint : point ∈ sample.1.pointSet)
    45	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement (PauliScalar params × PauliScalar params) Carrier) :
    46	    (measurement.postprocess (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).effect
    47	      (evalOpt sample.2.1 (projX (directPointToPauli params point)) polynomials.1,
    48	        evalOpt sample.2.2 (projZ (directPointToPauli params point)) polynomials.2) ≤
    49	      (measurement.postprocess (fun pair => some
    50	        ((directPointToPauli params point) (alphaVar params.m) * pair.1 +
    51	          (directPointToPauli params point) (betaVar params.m) * pair.2))).effect
    52	        ((directEvalOpt sample.1 point
    53	          (sublines.combinedPolynomial sample hsample polynomials)).map
    54	            (extendedDirectScalarEquiv params)) := by
    55	  classical
    56	  have hnoneX (value : Option (PauliScalar params)) :
    57	      (measurement.postprocess (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).effect (none, value) =
    58	        0 := by
    59	    rw [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
    60	    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    61	    intro pair hpair
    62	    have himpossible := congrArg Prod.fst (Finset.mem_filter.mp hpair).2
    63	    simp at himpossible
    64	  have hnoneZ (value : Option (PauliScalar params)) :
    65	      (measurement.postprocess (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).effect (value, none) =
    66	        0 := by
    67	    rw [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
    68	    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    69	    intro pair hpair
    70	    have himpossible := congrArg Prod.snd (Finset.mem_filter.mp hpair).2
    71	    simp at himpossible
    72	  cases hevalX : evalOpt sample.2.1 (projX (directPointToPauli params point)) polynomials.1 with
    73	  | none =>
    74	    erw [hnoneX]
    75	    exact Quantum.Submeasurement.pos _ _
    76	  | some valueX =>
    77	    cases hevalZ : evalOpt sample.2.2 (projZ (directPointToPauli params point)) polynomials.2 with
    78	    | none =>
    79	      erw [hnoneZ]
    80	      exact Quantum.Submeasurement.pos _ _
    81	    | some valueZ =>
    82	      rw [sublines.combinedPolynomial_evalOpt sample hsample polynomials point hpoint
    83	        valueX valueZ hevalX hevalZ]
    84	      have hinjective : Function.Injective
    85	          (fun pair : PauliScalar params × PauliScalar params => (some pair.1, some pair.2)) := by
    86	        intro left right hequal
    87	        exact Prod.ext (Option.some.inj (congrArg Prod.fst hequal))
    88	          (Option.some.inj (congrArg Prod.snd hequal))
    89	      erw [SandwichProduct.postprocess_effect_of_injective measurement _ hinjective
    90	        (valueX, valueZ)]
    91	      rw [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
    92	      exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun pair _ => measurement.pos pair)
    93	        (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)

   174	/-- Postprocessing the left measurement groups, but does not alter, its overlap
   175	with a family indexed by the postprocessed answer. -/
   176	private theorem placed_overlap_postprocess {params : AdmissibleParams} {error : ℝ}
   177	    {Answer Output : Type*} [Fintype Answer] [DecidableEq Answer]
   178	    [Fintype Output] [DecidableEq Output]
   179	    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (first second : Placement)
   180	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement Answer (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side))
   181	    (mapping : Answer → Output) (right : Output → Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side)) :
   182	    (∑ output, stateQForm setting.psiHat
   183	      (setting.place first ((measurement.postprocess mapping).effect output) *
   184	        setting.place second (right output))) =
   185	      ∑ answer, stateQForm setting.psiHat
   186	        (setting.place first (measurement.effect answer) *
   187	          setting.place second (right (mapping answer))) := by
   188	  classical
   189	  simp only [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, setting.place_finsetSum,
   190	    Finset.sum_mul, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   191	  calc
   192	    (∑ output, ∑ answer ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun answer => mapping answer = output),
   193	        stateQForm setting.psiHat (setting.place first (measurement.effect answer) *
   194	          setting.place second (right output))) =
   195	        ∑ output, ∑ answer ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun answer => mapping answer = output),
   196	          stateQForm setting.psiHat (setting.place first (measurement.effect answer) *
   197	            setting.place second (right (mapping answer))) := by
   198	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   199	      intro output _
   200	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   201	      intro answer hanswer
   202	      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hanswer).2]
   203	    _ = _ := Finset.sum_fiberwise _ _ _

   206	effect. This applies to both directed player placements without exchanging spaces. -/
   207	private theorem placed_overlap_mono {params : AdmissibleParams} {error : ℝ}
   208	    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (first second : Placement)
   209	    (hopposite : first.IsOpposite second)
   210	    (left : Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side))
   211	    (lower upper : Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side))
   212	    (hleft : 0 ≤ left) (hright : lower ≤ upper) :
   213	    stateQForm setting.psiHat (setting.place first left * setting.place second lower) ≤
   214	      stateQForm setting.psiHat (setting.place first left * setting.place second upper) := by

   216	    (sub_nonneg.mpr hright)

   218	  exact quadratic_form_mono (sub_nonneg.mp hpositive) setting.psiHat

   224	    {points : CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError}

   364	          (projZ (directPointToPauli params sample.2))).postprocess (fun values => some
   365	            ((directPointToPauli params sample.2) (alphaVar params.m) * values.1 +
   366	              (directPointToPauli params sample.2) (betaVar params.m) * values.2))).effect answer))
   367	      setting.psiHat ≤ 1 - avgOver sublines.D
   368	        (pairedSublineOverlap setting points lines first second) := by
   369	  erw [consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap (directLinePointDist params.extendedDirectLd)
   370	    (fun sample => setting.placedMeasurement first
   371	      ((sublines.extendedMeasurement lines first.side sample.1).postprocess
   372	        (fun polynomial => (directEvalOpt sample.1 sample.2 polynomial).map
   373	          (extendedDirectScalarEquiv params))))
   374	    (fun sample => setting.placedMeasurement second
   375	      ((points.Q second.side (projX (directPointToPauli params sample.2))
   376	        (projZ (directPointToPauli params sample.2))).postprocess (fun values => some
   377	          ((directPointToPauli params sample.2) (alphaVar params.m) * values.1 +
   378	            (directPointToPauli params sample.2) (betaVar params.m) * values.2))))

   381	
   382	/-- The ordered Z-then-X point overlap on the actual subline law. -/
   383	def orderedSublineOverlap {params : AdmissibleParams} {error pointError lineError : ℝ}
   384	    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (points : CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError)
   385	    (lines : CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError) (first second : Placement)
   386	    (sample : SubLineTriple params) : ℝ :=
   387	  avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)) (fun parameter =>
   388	    let point := directPointToPauli params (sample.1.base + parameter • sample.1.direction)
   389	    ∑ pair, stateQForm setting.psiHat
   390	      (setting.place first ((lines.T first.side sample.2.1 sample.2.2).effect pair) *
   391	        setting.place second
   392	          ((setting.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z (projZ point)).effect

   394	            (setting.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X (projX point)).effect

   397	/-- The first-route replacement by the ordered point product holds for any
   398	placement, in particular for the missing second-player orientation. Its only
   399	distributional input is the uniform joint point marginal, not a product law
   400	conditional on the projected lines. -/
   401	theorem SubLineWitness.paired_ordered_overlap_gap_le {params : AdmissibleParams}
   402	    {error pointError lineError : ℝ} {setting : ProjectiveSetting params error}
   403	    {points : CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError}
   404	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (lines : CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError)

   406	    |avgOver sublines.D (pairedSublineOverlap setting points lines first second) -
   407	      avgOver sublines.D (orderedSublineOverlap setting points lines first second)| ≤
   408	        Real.sqrt (4 * pointError) := by
   409	  let law := Distribution.prod sublines.D
   410	    (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd))
   411	  let point (sample : SubLineTriple params × DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd) :=
   412	    directPointToPauli params (sample.1.1.base + sample.2 • sample.1.1.direction)
   413	  let lineMeasurement (sample : SubLineTriple params × DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd) :=
   414	    setting.placedMeasurement first
   415	      ((lines.T first.side sample.1.2.1 sample.1.2.2).postprocess (fun pair =>
   416	        (evalOpt sample.1.2.1 (projX (point sample)) pair.1,
   417	          evalOpt sample.1.2.2 (projZ (point sample)) pair.2)))
   418	  let joint (sample : SubLineTriple params × DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)
   419	      (answer : Option (PauliScalar params) × Option (PauliScalar params)) :=
   420	    setting.place second (((points.Q second.side (projX (point sample))
   421	      (projZ (point sample))).postprocess (fun values => (some values.1, some values.2))).effect
   422	        answer)
   423	  let ordered (sample : SubLineTriple params × DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)
   424	      (answer : Option (PauliScalar params) × Option (PauliScalar params)) :=
   425	    setting.place second
   426	      ((setting.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z (projZ (point sample))).effect answer.2 *
   427	        (setting.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X (projX (point sample))).effect answer.1)
   428	  have hprob : law.IsProbability := Distribution.prod_isProbability _ _ sublines.isProbability
   429	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   430	  have hdist : opFamilyDistSq law joint ordered setting.psiHat ≤ 4 * pointError := by
   431	    unfold opFamilyDistSq
   432	    change avgOver law (fun sample => ∑ answer,
   433	      ‖applyOperatorToState (joint sample answer - ordered sample answer) setting.psiHat‖ ^ 2) ≤ _
   434	    have hcompleted := avgOver_congr law _ _ (fun sample =>
   435	      setting.completedPair_norm_sq_sum_ZX points second
   436	        (projX (point sample)) (projZ (point sample)))
   437	    dsimp only [joint, ordered] at *
   438	    rw [hcompleted]
   439	    change avgOver law (fun sample => ∑ answer : PauliScalar params × PauliScalar params,
   440	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   441	        (setting.place second ((points.Q second.side (projX (point sample))
   442	          (projZ (point sample))).effect answer) -
   443	          setting.place second
   444	            ((setting.pointMeasExp second.side .Z (projZ (point sample))).effect answer.2 *
   445	              (setting.pointMeasExp second.side .X (projX (point sample))).effect answer.1))
   446	        setting.psiHat‖ ^ 2) ≤ _
   447	    rw [show law = Distribution.prod sublines.D
   448	      (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)) from rfl, avgOver_prod]
   449	    dsimp only [point]
   450	    rw [SubLineWitness.avgOver_projX_projZ params sublines
   451	      (fun coordinates => ∑ answer : PauliScalar params × PauliScalar params,
   452	        ‖applyOperatorToState
   453	          (setting.place second ((points.Q second.side coordinates.1 coordinates.2).effect answer) -
   454	            setting.place second
   455	              ((setting.pointMeasExp second.side .Z coordinates.2).effect answer.2 *
   456	                (setting.pointMeasExp second.side .X coordinates.1).effect answer.1))
   457	          setting.psiHat‖ ^ 2)]
   458	    exact points.orderedZX_dist_le second
   459	  have hgap := abs_overlap_gap_le_sqrt_of_opFamilyDistSq law lineMeasurement joint ordered
   460	    setting.psiHat hprob setting.psiHat_norm (4 * pointError) hdist
   461	  have hregroup (right : (SubLineTriple params × DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd) →
   462	      Option (PauliScalar params) × Option (PauliScalar params) →
   463	        Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side)) :
   464	      avgOver law (fun sample => ∑ answer, stateQForm setting.psiHat
   465	        ((lineMeasurement sample).effect answer * setting.place second (right sample answer))) =
   466	      avgOver sublines.D (fun sample =>
   467	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)) (fun parameter =>
   468	          ∑ pair, stateQForm setting.psiHat
   469	            (setting.place first ((lines.T first.side sample.2.1 sample.2.2).effect pair) *
   470	              setting.place second (right (sample, parameter)
   471	                (evalOpt sample.2.1 (projX (point (sample, parameter))) pair.1,
   472	                  evalOpt sample.2.2 (projZ (point (sample, parameter))) pair.2))))) := by
   473	    change avgOver (Distribution.prod sublines.D
   474	      (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd))) _ = _
   475	    rw [avgOver_prod]
   476	    apply avgOver_congr
   477	    intro sample
   478	    apply avgOver_congr
   479	    intro parameter
   480	    exact placed_overlap_postprocess setting first second _ _ _
   481	  dsimp only [joint, ordered] at hgap
   482	  rw [hregroup, hregroup] at hgap
   483	  exact hgap
   484	
   485	
   486	end

     4	/-!
     5	# Restricting and completing global polynomial-pair measurements
     6	
     7	The combining map embeds pairs of bounded individual-degree polynomials into
     8	extended polynomials. Restricting a measurement along this embedding produces a
     9	submeasurement whose missing operator is the sum of the noncombined effects.
    10	Relabeling those effects by one specified pair completes the measurement and
    11	preserves projectivity.
    12	
    13	These algebraic constructions do not establish the concentration estimate
    14	`eq:qld-g-non-separable` or the point consistency required by
    15	`exists_globalPairWitness`. Issue #513 retains those obligations.
    16	
    17	Recovered read-only from PR535 at `1744bd9533055b9b43af9a8d46906cbafb69afdd`.
    18	This continuation transports the construction; it earns no new algebraic proof credit.
    19	
    20	## References
    21	
    22	- Blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
    23	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1375-1404`,
    24	  `eq:qld-sgg-completeness` and the final completion paragraph.
    25	- Restriction and completion proofs recovered from commit `cb6d86d8`;
    26	  the evaluation identity is from `3de03d0a`, as preserved at `aaa5cb48`.
    27	-/
    28	
    29	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    30	
    31	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder
    32	
    33	noncomputable section
    34	
    35	/-- Recover the two polynomial components by setting the unused block to zero
    36	and the scalar coordinates to `(1,0)` or `(0,1)`. This algebraic substitution
    37	is the left inverse implicit in the restriction to combined outcomes in
    38	`eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. Unlike evaluation as a
    39	polynomial function on a finite field, it does not require a degree bound. -/
    40	noncomputable def recoverCombinedPair {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ}
    41	    (polynomial : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * m + 2)) K) :
    42	    MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K :=
    43	  (MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C (fun index =>
    44	    match finCombineEquiv m index with
    45	    | .inl (.inl coordinate) => MvPolynomial.X coordinate
    46	    | .inl (.inr _) => 0
    47	    | .inr scalar => if scalar = 0 then 1 else 0) polynomial,
    48	   MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C (fun index =>
    49	    match finCombineEquiv m index with
    50	    | .inl (.inl _) => 0
    51	    | .inl (.inr coordinate) => MvPolynomial.X coordinate
    52	    | .inr scalar => if scalar = 1 then 1 else 0) polynomial)
    53	
    54	/-- Substitution recovers both components of a combined polynomial. This is
    55	formalization support for the relabeling in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper
    56	lines 1375--1380. -/
    57	@[simp] theorem recoverCombinedPair_combinePoly {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ}
    58	    (first second : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K) :
    59	    recoverCombinedPair (combinePoly first second) = (first, second) := by
    60	  simp [recoverCombinedPair, combinePoly, MvPolynomial.eval₂_rename,
    61	    embX, embZ, alphaVar, betaVar, Function.comp_def, MvPolynomial.eval₂_eta]
    62	
    63	/-- Distinct polynomial pairs label distinct combined outcomes. This justifies
    64	restricting a measurement on extended polynomials to pairs without duplicating
    65	an effect in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. -/
    66	theorem combinePoly_injective {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ} :
    67	    Function.Injective (fun pair : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K =>
    68	      combinePoly pair.1 pair.2) := by
    69	  exact (show Function.LeftInverse recoverCombinedPair
    70	    (fun pair : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K =>
    71	      combinePoly pair.1 pair.2) from fun pair =>
    72	        recoverCombinedPair_combinePoly pair.1 pair.2).injective
    73	
    74	/-- The bounded polynomial-pair embedding used to restrict the global
    75	measurement in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. The degree
    76	bound is inherited from `def:combine-map`; the two scalar coordinates have
    77	degree one, allowed by admissibility. -/
    78	noncomputable def combinedPolyEmbedding (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    79	    PolyPair P ↪ MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d where
    80	  toFun pair := ⟨combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1,
    81	    combinePoly_mem_polyFunc P.hd pair.1.2 pair.2.2⟩
    82	  inj' := by
    83	    intro first second heq
    84	    have hpoly : combinePoly first.1.1 first.2.1 = combinePoly second.1.1 second.2.1 :=
    85	      congrArg Subtype.val heq
    86	    have hpair : (first.1.1, first.2.1) = (second.1.1, second.2.1) :=
    87	      combinePoly_injective hpoly
    88	    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.fst hpair))
    89	      (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.snd hpair))
    90	
    91	/-- Evaluation of a combined outcome is the affine combination of its two
    92	components.  This is the pointwise algebraic identity used when transferring
    93	the global-pair measurement to the expanded point measurements in
    94	`lem:qld-4-7`, paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1364--1380`.
    95	It is a formalization-only consequence of `def:combine-map`; it does not assert
    96	any consistency or quantitative error estimate.
    97	-/
    98	theorem combinedPolyEmbedding_eval (P : AdmissibleParams)
    99	    (u : Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → PauliScalar P) (pair : PolyPair P) :
   100	    MvPolynomial.eval u (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair).1 =
   101	      u (alphaVar P.m) * evalAt .X (projX u) pair +
   102	        u (betaVar P.m) * evalAt .Z (projZ u) pair := by
   103	  change MvPolynomial.eval u (combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1) = _
   104	  rw [combinePoly_eval]
   105	  rfl
   106	
   107	/-- Restrict an extended-polynomial measurement to combined outcomes, as in
   108	`eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. Injectivity of the combining
   109	map ensures that the retained effects sum to at most the identity. This
   110	construction does not assert the source's quantitative completeness bound. -/
   111	noncomputable def combinedPairSubmeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams)
   112	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   113	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   114	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier) :
   115	    Quantum.Submeasurement (PolyPair P) carrier where
   116	  effect pair := measurement.effect (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair)
   117	  pos pair := measurement.pos _
   118	  sum_le_one := by
   119	    classical
   120	    rw [← Finset.sum_image (fun first _ second _ heq =>
   121	      (combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective heq)]
   122	    exact (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
   123	      (fun outcome _ _ => measurement.pos outcome)).trans measurement.sum_le_one
   124	
   125	/-- Restricting to combined outcomes preserves projectivity, as asserted
   126	before `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. -/
   127	theorem combinedPairSubmeasurement_projective (P : AdmissibleParams)
   128	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   129	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   130	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier)
   131	    (hprojective : Measurement.IsProjective measurement) :
   132	    ∀ pair, Quantum.IsProj ((combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).effect pair) := by
   133	  intro pair
   134	  exact hprojective (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair)
   135	
   136	/-- The missing operator of the polynomial-pair submeasurement is exactly the
   137	sum of the effects outside the range of the combining map. This is the
   138	operator identity underlying `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380;
   139	the bound on its state mass is a separate obligation. -/
   140	theorem combinedPairSubmeasurement_missing (P : AdmissibleParams)
   141	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   142	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   143	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier) :
   144	    1 - (combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).total =
   145	      ∑ polynomial ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   146	        (fun polynomial => polynomial ∉ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)),
   147	        measurement.effect polynomial := by
   148	  classical
   149	  have htotal : (combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).total =
   150	      ∑ polynomial ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   151	        (fun polynomial => polynomial ∈ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)),
   152	        measurement.effect polynomial := by
   153	    change (∑ pair, measurement.effect (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair)) = _
   154	    rw [← Finset.sum_image (fun first _ second _ heq =>
   155	      (combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective heq)]
   156	    congr 1
   157	    ext polynomial
   158	    simp
   159	  rw [htotal, ← measurement.sum_eq_one]
   160	  apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr
   161	  exact (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ
   162	    (fun polynomial => polynomial ∈ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P))
   163	    measurement.effect).symm.trans (add_comm _ _)
   164	
   165	/-- Relabel a combined polynomial by its unique pair and send every other
   166	polynomial to a specified pair. This implements the completion at an arbitrary
   167	outcome in the last paragraph of `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404. The
   168	noncombined outcomes are retained at the completion outcome, not discarded. -/
   169	noncomputable def completedPairLabel (P : AdmissibleParams) (completionPair : PolyPair P) :
   170	    MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d → PolyPair P :=
   171	  Function.extend (combinedPolyEmbedding P) id (fun _ => completionPair)
   172	
   173	/-- Completion preserves every combined polynomial's pair label. -/
   174	@[simp] theorem completedPairLabel_combinedPolyEmbedding (P : AdmissibleParams)
   175	    (completionPair pair : PolyPair P) :
   176	    completedPairLabel P completionPair (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair) = pair := by
   177	  exact (combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective.extend_apply _ _ _
   178	
   179	/-- All outcomes outside the combining map's range go to the completion pair. -/
   180	theorem completedPairLabel_of_not_mem_range (P : AdmissibleParams)
   181	    (completionPair : PolyPair P)
   182	    (polynomial : MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d)
   183	    (houtside : polynomial ∉ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)) :
   184	    completedPairLabel P completionPair polynomial = completionPair := by
   185	  exact Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ houtside
   186	
   187	/-- The completed polynomial-pair measurement of the final paragraph of
   188	`lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404, obtained by relabeling all extended
   189	polynomial outcomes. No assertion about consistency is built into this
   190	construction. -/
   191	noncomputable def completedPairMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams)
   192	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   193	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   194	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier)
   195	    (completionPair : PolyPair P) : Quantum.Measurement (PolyPair P) carrier :=
   196	  measurement.postprocess (completedPairLabel P completionPair)
   197	
   198	/-- Completing the pair measurement adds precisely its missing operator to
   199	the specified outcome and leaves all other effects unchanged. This is the
   200	completion formula of `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404. -/
   201	theorem completedPairMeasurement_effect (P : AdmissibleParams)
   202	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   203	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   204	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier)
   205	    (completionPair pair : PolyPair P) :
   206	    (completedPairMeasurement P measurement completionPair).effect pair =
   207	      (combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).effect pair +
   208	        if pair = completionPair then 1 - (combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).total
   209	        else 0 := by
   210	  classical
   211	  rw [completedPairMeasurement, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
   212	  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ
   213	    (fun polynomial => polynomial ∈ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P))]
   214	  have hgood :
   215	      Finset.univ.filter (fun polynomial => polynomial ∈ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)) =
   216	        Finset.univ.image (combinedPolyEmbedding P) := by
   217	    ext polynomial
   218	    simp
   219	  rw [hgood, Finset.sum_image (fun first _ second _ heq =>
   220	    (combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective heq)]
   221	  simp only [completedPairLabel_combinedPolyEmbedding]
   222	  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos (Finset.mem_univ pair)]
   223	  congr 1
   224	  have hbad :
   225	      (∑ polynomial ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   226	        (fun polynomial => polynomial ∉ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)),
   227	        if completedPairLabel P completionPair polynomial = pair then
   228	          measurement.effect polynomial else 0) =
   229	      ∑ polynomial ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   230	        (fun polynomial => polynomial ∉ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)),
   231	        if completionPair = pair then measurement.effect polynomial else 0 := by
   232	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   233	    intro polynomial hpolynomial
   234	    rw [completedPairLabel_of_not_mem_range P completionPair polynomial
   235	      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hpolynomial).2]
   236	  rw [hbad]
   237	  by_cases heq : pair = completionPair
   238	  · simp [heq, combinedPairSubmeasurement_missing]
   239	  · simp [heq, Ne.symm heq]
   240	
   241	/-- The completed polynomial-pair measurement is projective whenever the
   242	extended-polynomial measurement is projective. This proves the qualitative
   243	completion step in `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404, without assuming its
   244	unproved consistency conclusion. -/
   245	theorem completedPairMeasurement_projective (P : AdmissibleParams)
   246	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   247	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   248	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier)
   249	    (hprojective : Measurement.IsProjective measurement) (completionPair : PolyPair P) :
   250	    Measurement.IsProjective (completedPairMeasurement P measurement completionPair) := by
   251	  exact SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective measurement hprojective _
   252	
   253	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
   254	
   255	/-- Completion can only increase agreement with any evaluated reference
   256	measurement on the opposite tensor factor. Consequently, its consistency
   257	defect is at most the squared state norm minus the retained diagonal overlap.
   258	This is the completion step of `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404, for an
   259	arbitrary outcome evaluation; it does not supply the preceding overlap bound.
   260	Neither projectivity nor normalization of the state is needed. -/
   261	theorem completedPairMeasurement_evaluated_defect_le (P : AdmissibleParams)
   262	    {Answer Left Right : Type*} [Fintype Answer] [DecidableEq Answer]
   263	    [Fintype Left] [DecidableEq Left] [Fintype Right] [DecidableEq Right]
   264	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   265	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) Left)
   266	    (completionPair : PolyPair P) (eval : PolyPair P → Answer)
   267	    (reference : Quantum.Measurement Answer Right)
   268	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Left × Right)) :
   269	    (∑ a : Answer, ∑ b : Answer, if a = b then 0 else
   270	      stateQForm psi (heteroKron
   271	        (((completedPairMeasurement P measurement completionPair).postprocess eval).effect a)
   272	        (reference.effect b))) ≤
   273	      ‖psi‖ ^ 2 - ∑ pair : PolyPair P, stateQForm psi
   274	        (heteroKron ((combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).effect pair)
   275	          (reference.effect (eval pair))) := by
   276	  classical
   277	  let completed := completedPairMeasurement P measurement completionPair
   278	  have hdiag :
   279	      (∑ a : Answer, stateQForm psi
   280	        (heteroKron ((completed.postprocess eval).effect a) (reference.effect a))) =
   281	        ∑ pair : PolyPair P, stateQForm psi
   282	          (heteroKron (completed.effect pair) (reference.effect (eval pair))) := by
   283	    simp_rw [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, heteroKron_finset_sum_left,
   284	      stateQForm_finset_sum]
   285	    calc
   286	      _ = ∑ a : Answer, ∑ pair ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun pair => eval pair = a),
   287	          stateQForm psi
   288	            (heteroKron (completed.effect pair) (reference.effect (eval pair))) := by
   289	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   290	        intro a _
   291	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   292	        intro pair hpair
   293	        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hpair).2]
   294	      _ = _ := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ eval _
   295	  have hretained :
   296	      (∑ pair : PolyPair P, stateQForm psi
   297	        (heteroKron ((combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).effect pair)
   298	          (reference.effect (eval pair)))) ≤
   299	        ∑ pair : PolyPair P, stateQForm psi
   300	          (heteroKron (completed.effect pair) (reference.effect (eval pair))) := by
   301	    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   302	    intro pair _
   303	    dsimp [completed]
   304	    rw [completedPairMeasurement_effect]
   305	    by_cases hpair : pair = completionPair
   306	    · rw [if_pos hpair, heteroKron_add_left, stateQForm_add]
   307	      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (stateQForm_nonneg psi
   308	        (kronecker_nonneg
   309	          (sub_nonneg.mpr (combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).total_le_one)
   310	          (reference.pos (eval pair))))
   311	    · simp [hpair]
   312	  have hdefect := point_defect_eq
   313	    (leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := Right) (completed.postprocess eval))
   314	    (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := Left) reference) psi
   315	  simp only [leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement,
   316	    Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne] at hdefect
   317	  simp_rw [placed_product_stateQForm_eq] at hdefect
   318	  change _ ≤ _
   319	  rw [hdefect, hdiag]
   320	  exact sub_le_sub_left hretained _
   321	
   322	/-- Uniformly averaging the completion estimate gives the consistency defect
   323	needed for the point marginals in `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404.
   324	The retained overlap remains explicit and must be bounded from the source
   325	strategy before this estimate can establish global-pair existence. -/
   326	theorem completedPairMeasurement_consistencyDefect_le (P : AdmissibleParams)
   327	    {Question Answer Left Right : Type*}
   328	    [Fintype Question] [DecidableEq Question] [Nonempty Question]
   329	    [Fintype Answer] [DecidableEq Answer]
   330	    [Fintype Left] [DecidableEq Left] [Fintype Right] [DecidableEq Right]
   331	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   332	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) Left)
   333	    (completionPair : PolyPair P) (eval : Question → PolyPair P → Answer)
   334	    (reference : Question → Quantum.Measurement Answer Right)
   335	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Left × Right)) :
   336	    consistencyDefect (MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Question)
   337	      (fun x a => heteroKron
   338	        (((completedPairMeasurement P measurement completionPair).postprocess (eval x)).effect a)
   339	        (1 : Op Right))
   340	      (fun x a => heteroKron (1 : Op Left) ((reference x).effect a)) psi ≤
   341	      ‖psi‖ ^ 2 - MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Question)
   342	        (fun x => ∑ pair : PolyPair P, stateQForm psi
   343	          (heteroKron ((combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).effect pair)
   344	            ((reference x).effect (eval x pair)))) := by
   345	  rw [SandwichProduct.consistencyDefect_placed_eq_avg_point]
   346	  have h := MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_mono (MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Question) _ _
   347	    (fun x => completedPairMeasurement_evaluated_defect_le P measurement completionPair
   348	      (eval x) (reference x) psi)
   349	  simpa only [MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_sub, MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_uniform_const] using h
   350	
   351	end
   352	
   353	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     4	/-!
     5	# Scalar-nonlinear mass of the actual rounded measurements
     6	
     7	The full polynomial-outcome ordered estimate is composed with the concentration
     8	proof recovered from PR296. Opposite placements commute; no symmetry of the
     9	player spaces is required. Projectivity retains the actual outcome masses.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	`eq:qld-g-42`, `eq:qld-g-prime`, and `eq:qld-g-prime-bound`, paper
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1283-1326`.
    15	PR296 proof provenance: `2c8f147643d151d8616864cf49817dc6422a9a86`.
    16	This is only scalar-linearity concentration; issue #513 still requires both
    17	variable-separation estimates and retained overlaps.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    21	
    22	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    23	
    24	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    25	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus PolynomialImageBounds

    29	namespace ExtendedLineGame
    30	
    31	/-- Actual mass of outcomes outside `alpha*g1(x,z) + beta*g2(x,z)`. The
    32	coefficients may still depend on both base blocks. -/
    33	def scalarNonlinearMass {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    34	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement)
    35	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) : ℝ := by
    36	  classical
    37	  exact ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g => ¬ ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m))
    38	      (PauliScalar P), scalarPolynomial P g =
    39	        MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1),
    40	    ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p (R.effect g)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2
    41	
    42	private theorem placed_orderedIndicator {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    43	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) (x : ExtendedPointQuestion P)
    44	    (a : PauliScalar P) :
    45	    orderedIndicator (S.placedMeasurement p (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X x.1.1))
    46	      (S.placedMeasurement p (S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z x.1.2)) x.2.1 x.2.2 a =
    47	    S.place p (∑ ab ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P =>
    48	        x.2.1 * ab.1 + x.2.2 * ab.2 = a),
    49	      (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X x.1.1).effect ab.1 *
    50	        (S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z x.1.2).effect ab.2) := by
    51	  rw [S.place_finsetSum, Finset.sum_filter]
    52	  simp only [orderedIndicator, ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect,
    53	    ProjectiveSetting.place_mul]
    54	
    55	/-- Opposite placements commute, identifying the residual on the actual
    56	projected state with the ordered-error residual. This supports both orders
    57	of `eq:qld-g-42/43` and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    58	theorem placed_residual {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    59	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopposite : p1.IsOpposite p2)
    60	    (R : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side)) (T : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p2.side)) :
    61	    applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 R) S.psiHat -
    62	      applyOperatorToState (S.place p2 T)
    63	        (applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 R) S.psiHat) =
    64	      applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 R * (1 - S.place p2 T)) S.psiHat := by
    65	  rw [← applyOperatorToState_mul, ← S.place_comm p1 p2 hopposite R T, mul_sub, mul_one]
    66	  simp only [applyOperatorToState, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
    67	
    68	/-- The scalar-nonlinear outcome mass is bounded by twice the actual full
    69	ordered error plus `2*((2m+2)d+1)/q`. All transports and degree bounds are
    70	derived internally from the actual singleton outcomes. This auxiliary applies
    71	to every opposite placement of a complete projective measurement. -/
    72	theorem scalarNonlinearMass_le_ordered_error {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    73	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopposite : p1.IsOpposite p2)
    74	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    75	    (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R) :
    76	    scalarNonlinearMass S p1 R ≤ 2 * extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R false +
    77	      2 * (((2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q := by
    78	  classical
    79	  let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun g => ¬ ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m))
    80	      (PauliScalar P), scalarPolynomial P g =
    81	        MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1)
    82	  let ψ := fun g => applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 (R.effect g)) S.psiHat
    83	  let X := fun u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P => S.placedMeasurement p2
    84	    (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X (fun i => u ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inl i))))
    85	  let Z := fun u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P => S.placedMeasurement p2
    86	    (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z (fun i => u ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inr i))))
    87	  have hX : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (X u) := fun u =>
    88	    S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p2 _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _)
    89	  have hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u) := fun u =>
    90	    S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p2 _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _)
    91	  have h := nonlinear_mass_le_ordered_error s (scalarPolynomial P)
    92	    (fun g hg => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hg).2) X Z hX hZ ψ
    93	  have hmass : ∑ g, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    94	    simpa only [ψ, ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect, S.psiHat_norm, one_pow] using
    95	      sum_projective_state_norm_sq (S.placedMeasurement p1 R)
    96	        (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p1 R hR) S.psiHat
    97	  have hdegree : (∑ g ∈ s,
    98	      (((scalarPolynomial P g).support.sup fun e =>
    99	          ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff e).totalDegree) +
   100	        max 1 (scalarPolynomial P g).totalDegree + 1 : ℕ) /
   101	          (Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℝ) * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2) ≤
   102	      (((2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q := by
   103	    have hcard : Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) = P.q :=
   104	      @FieldModel.card P.q P.model.toFieldModel
   105	    rw [hcard]
   106	    calc
   107	      _ ≤ ∑ g ∈ s, ((((2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q) * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 := by
   108	        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   109	        intro g _
   110	        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
   111	        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
   112	        exact_mod_cast scalarPolynomial_degree_term_le P g
   113	      _ ≤ ∑ g, ((((2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q) * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 :=
   114	        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (by
   115	          intros; positivity)
   116	      _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hmass, mul_one]
   117	  let f := fun (u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) g =>
   118	    ‖ψ g - applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   119	      (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u)
   120	        (scalarPolynomial P g)))) (ψ g)‖ ^ 2
   121	  have hfull : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   122	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v => ∑ g, f u v g)) =
   123	        extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R false := by
   124	    rw [← avgOver_uniform_prod (fun u v => ∑ g, f u v g)]
   125	    unfold extendedPolynomialOrderedError
   126	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P).symm]
   127	    apply avgOver_congr
   128	    rintro ⟨u, v⟩
   129	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   130	    intro g _
   131	    dsimp only [f]
   132	    rw [scalarPolynomial_eval]
   133	    have hXZ : orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   134	        (extendedPolynomialRead P (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)) g) =
   135	        orderedIndicator
   136	          (S.placedMeasurement p2 (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X
   137	            (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)).1.1))
   138	          (S.placedMeasurement p2 (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z
   139	            (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)).1.2))
   140	          (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)).2.1
   141	          (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)).2.2
   142	          (extendedPolynomialRead P (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)) g) := by
   143	      simp [X, Z, scalarBaseQuestionEquiv, Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply]
   144	    rw [hXZ, placed_orderedIndicator]
   145	    dsimp only [ψ]
   146	    rw [placed_residual S p1 p2 hopposite]
   147	    rfl
   148	  have herror : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   149	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s, f u v g)) ≤
   150	        extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R false := by
   151	    rw [← hfull]
   152	    apply avgOver_mono
   153	    intro u
   154	    apply avgOver_mono
   155	    intro v
   156	    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (by
   157	      intros; exact sq_nonneg _)
   158	  change scalarNonlinearMass S p1 R ≤ 2 * _ + 2 * _ at h
   159	  have hout := h.trans (add_le_add
   160	    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left herror (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
   161	    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdegree (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)))
   162	  simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using hout
   163	
   164	/-- Actual rounded measurements satisfy scalar-linearity concentration for both
   165	player placements, with all point, line, soundness, and rounding errors retained.
   166	The measurements are produced by `exists_rounded_polynomial_ordered_estimates`;
   167	neither an ordered estimate nor a mass bound is an assumption. Both ordered
   168	estimates remain available for the subsequent variable-separation argument.
   169	
   170	The directly indexed, completed-answer line witness is an explicit restriction
   171	of this auxiliary, as documented in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
   172	and `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex`. This proves only the
   173	scalar-linearity calculation `eq:qld-g-prime-bound`, not `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   174	theorem exists_rounded_polynomial_scalar_mass :
   175	    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
   176	      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε δQ δL : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   177	        (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ) (_lines : ExtendedLinesWitness S points δL),
   178	      let delta := deltaLd a b
   179	        (directPassingErrorEnvelope (δQ + δL) ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q))
   180	        P.q (2 * P.m + 2) P.d 1
   181	      let eta := delta + Real.sqrt (220 * Real.rpow delta (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
   182	        2 * Real.sqrt (2 * delta)
   183	      ∃ RA : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice),
   184	      ∃ RB : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob),
   185	        Measurement.IsProjective RA ∧ Measurement.IsProjective RB ∧
   186	        (∀ reverse : Bool,
   187	          extendedPolynomialOrderedError S .AA' .BA'' RA reverse ≤ 4 * eta + 8 * δQ ∧
   188	          extendedPolynomialOrderedError S .BB' .AB'' RB reverse ≤ 4 * eta + 8 * δQ) ∧
   189	        scalarNonlinearMass S .AA' RA ≤ 2 * (4 * eta + 8 * δQ) +
   190	          2 * (((2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q ∧
   191	        scalarNonlinearMass S .BB' RB ≤ 2 * (4 * eta + 8 * δQ) +
   192	          2 * (((2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q := by
   193	  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, h⟩ := exists_rounded_polynomial_ordered_estimates
   194	  refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, ?_⟩
   195	  intro P ε δQ δL S points lines delta eta

     4	/-!
     5	# Scalar and base coefficients of the rounded polynomial outcomes
     6	
     7	The singleton polynomial is transported through the canonical field equivalence
     8	and Mathlib's equivalence between a polynomial in a sum of variables and an
     9	iterated polynomial ring. Its individual-degree certificate controls both levels.
    10	Splitting each base coefficient by either block gives the partial degrees used
    11	in the fiber calculation. Independence of both wrong blocks identifies the
    12	outcome with the existing bounded polynomial-pair combining map.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1310-1326`,
    17	the coefficient expansion preceding `eq:qld-g-prime-bound`.
    18	The partial coefficient argument and separated image are at lines 1341--1368,
    19	`eq:qld-g-2` and `eq:qld-g-non-separable`; blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
    20	-/

    32	private theorem coeff_coeff_sumRingEquiv {F A B : Type*} [CommSemiring F]
    33	    (p : MvPolynomial (A ⊕ B) F) (a : A →₀ ℕ) (b : B →₀ ℕ) :
    34	    ((MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F A B p).coeff a).coeff b =
    35	      p.coeff (Finsupp.sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp.symm (a, b)) := by
    36	  simp [MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv, MvPolynomial.coeff,
    37	    AddMonoidAlgebra.curryRingEquiv, AddMonoidAlgebra.curryAddEquiv]

    39	private theorem totalDegree_le_of_exponents {F : Type*} [CommSemiring F]
    40	    {n d : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F)
    41	    (h : ∀ e ∈ p.support, ∀ i, e i ≤ d) : p.totalDegree ≤ n * d := by
    42	  rw [MvPolynomial.totalDegree, Finset.sup_le_iff]
    43	  intro e he
    44	  rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (by simp)]
    45	  calc
    46	    ∑ i : Fin n, e i ≤ ∑ _i : Fin n, d := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => h e he i
    47	    _ = n * d := by simp

    49	private theorem sumRingEquiv_degrees {F : Type*} [CommSemiring F] {k n d : ℕ}
    50	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin n) F)
    51	    (h : ∀ e ∈ p.support, ∀ i, e i ≤ d) :
    52	    (∀ a, ((MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F (Fin k) (Fin n) p).coeff a).totalDegree ≤
    53	      n * d) ∧ (MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F (Fin k) (Fin n) p).totalDegree ≤ k * d := by
    54	  have hc (a : Fin k →₀ ℕ) (b : Fin n →₀ ℕ)
    55	      (hb : b ∈ ((MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F (Fin k) (Fin n) p).coeff a).support) :
    56	      Finsupp.sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp.symm (a, b) ∈ p.support := by
    57	    simpa only [MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff, coeff_coeff_sumRingEquiv] using hb
    58	  constructor
    59	  · intro a
    60	    apply totalDegree_le_of_exponents
    61	    intro b hb i
    62	    simpa using h _ (hc a b hb) (Sum.inr i)
    63	  · apply totalDegree_le_of_exponents
    64	    intro a ha i
    65	    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := MvPolynomial.support_nonempty.mpr
    66	      (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp ha)
    67	    simpa using h _ (hc a b hb) (Sum.inl i)

    69	/-- The two base blocks, in the order `x,z` used by the extended game. -/
    70	def baseCoordinateEquiv (m : ℕ) : Fin (2 * m) ≃ Fin m ⊕ Fin m :=
    71	  (finCongr (by omega)).trans finSumFinEquiv.symm
    72	
    73	/-- The scalar coordinates first, followed by the combined base coordinates. -/
    74	def scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv (m : ℕ) : Fin (2 * m + 2) ≃ Fin 2 ⊕ Fin (2 * m) :=
    75	  (finCombineEquiv m).trans
    76	    ((Equiv.sumCongr (baseCoordinateEquiv m).symm (Equiv.refl _)).trans
    77	      (Equiv.sumComm _ _))

    79	/-- The actual singleton outcome as a polynomial in `alpha,beta` with
    80	coefficients in the `2m` base variables, over the canonical Pauli field. -/
    81	def scalarPolynomial (P : AdmissibleParams) (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) :
    82	    MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P)) :=
    83	  MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv _ _ _
    84	    (MvPolynomial.rename (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m)
    85	      (MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1))

    87	private theorem scalarPolynomial_renamed_exponents (P : AdmissibleParams)
    88	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) :
    89	    ∀ e ∈ (MvPolynomial.rename (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m)
    90	      (MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1)).support,
    91	      ∀ i, e i ≤ P.d := by
    92	  intro e he i
    93	  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvp⟩ := MvPolynomial.coeff_rename_ne_zero _ _ _
    94	    (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp he)
    95	  have hmem := MvPolynomial.support_map_subset _ _ (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hvp)
    96	  have hdeg := Preliminaries.degreeOf_le_of_mem_polyFunc (g (0 : Fin 1)).2
    97	    ((scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm i)
    98	  have hvbound := (MvPolynomial.le_degreeOf_of_mem_support _ hmem).trans hdeg
    99	  change v ((scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm i) ≤ P.d at hvbound
   100	  subst e
   101	  simpa only [Finsupp.mapDomain_equiv_apply] using hvbound

   103	/-- Both degree bounds follow from the genuine individual-degree certificate:
   104	every base coefficient has degree at most `2md`, and the outer scalar
   105	polynomial has degree at most `2d`. No degree hypothesis is added. -/
   106	theorem scalarPolynomial_degrees (P : AdmissibleParams)
   107	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) :
   108	    (∀ a, ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a).totalDegree ≤ 2 * P.m * P.d) ∧
   109	      (scalarPolynomial P g).totalDegree ≤ 2 * P.d := by
   110	  exact sumRingEquiv_degrees _ (scalarPolynomial_renamed_exponents P g)

   112	/-- Split a base coefficient into a polynomial in either varying block with
   113	coefficients in the fixed block. The value `false` selects `x` as varying and
   114	`true` selects `z`. This supports the two applications of `eq:qld-g-2` in
   115	paper lines 1341--1358 and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   116	def blockCoefficientPolynomial (P : AdmissibleParams)
   117	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool) :
   118	    MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (PauliScalar P)) :=
   119	  MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv _ _ _ (MvPolynomial.rename
   120	    ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   121	      (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)) ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a))

   123	private theorem blockCoefficientPolynomial_renamed_exponents (P : AdmissibleParams)
   124	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool) :
   125	    ∀ e ∈ (MvPolynomial.rename ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   126	      (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _))
   127	        ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a)).support, ∀ i, e i ≤ P.d := by
   128	  intro e he i
   129	  let eqv := (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   130	    (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)
   131	  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvp⟩ := MvPolynomial.coeff_rename_ne_zero _ _ _
   132	    (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp he)
   133	  have hcoeff :
   134	      (MvPolynomial.rename (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m)
   135	        (MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1)).coeff
   136	        (Finsupp.sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp.symm (a, v)) ≠ 0 := by
   137	    simpa only [scalarPolynomial, coeff_coeff_sumRingEquiv] using hvp
   138	  have hb := scalarPolynomial_renamed_exponents P g _
   139	    (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hcoeff) (.inr (eqv.symm i))
   140	  change v (eqv.symm i) ≤ P.d at hb
   141	  subst e
   142	  simpa only [Finsupp.mapDomain_equiv_apply] using hb

   144	/-- Both partial degrees are at most `md`, for either choice of varying
   145	block, directly from the actual outcome's individual-degree certificate.
   146	This supplies the coefficient and fiber bounds in `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting
   147	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`; no degree or specialization premise is added. -/
   148	theorem blockCoefficientPolynomial_degrees (P : AdmissibleParams)
   149	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool) :
   150	    (∀ e, ((blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse).coeff e).totalDegree ≤ P.m * P.d) ∧
   151	      (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse).totalDegree ≤ P.m * P.d := by
   152	  exact sumRingEquiv_degrees _ (blockCoefficientPolynomial_renamed_exponents P g a reverse)

   154	/-- The field and coordinate transports preserve the complete singleton
   155	polynomial outcome, including its formal coefficients, not only its values. -/
   156	theorem scalarPolynomial_injective (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   157	    Function.Injective (scalarPolynomial P) := by
   158	  intro g h heq
   159	  have hs := (MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv (PauliScalar P) (Fin 2)
   160	    (Fin (2 * P.m))).injective heq
   161	  have hr := MvPolynomial.rename_injective (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m)
   162	    (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m).injective hs
   163	  have hc := MvPolynomial.map_injective (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom
   164	    (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).injective hr
   165	  funext j
   166	  have hj : j = (0 : Fin 1) := @Subsingleton.elim (Fin 1) _ j 0
   167	  subst j
   168	  exact Subtype.ext hc

   170	/-- The combined degree term in the recovered concentration estimate. -/
   171	theorem scalarPolynomial_degree_term_le (P : AdmissibleParams)
   172	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) :
   173	    ((scalarPolynomial P g).support.sup fun e =>
   174	      ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff e).totalDegree) +
   175	        max 1 (scalarPolynomial P g).totalDegree + 1 ≤ (2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 := by
   176	  have h := scalarPolynomial_degrees P g
   177	  have hc : ((scalarPolynomial P g).support.sup fun e =>
   178	      ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff e).totalDegree) ≤ 2 * P.m * P.d :=
   179	    Finset.sup_le fun e _ => h.1 e
   180	  have ho : max 1 (scalarPolynomial P g).totalDegree ≤ 2 * P.d :=
   181	    max_le (by have := P.hd; omega) h.2
   182	  calc
   183	    _ ≤ 2 * P.m * P.d + 2 * P.d + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.add_le_add hc ho) 1
   184	    _ = _ := by ring

   186	private theorem eval_sumRingEquiv {F A B : Type*} [CommSemiring F]
   187	    (p : MvPolynomial (A ⊕ B) F) (u : B → F) (v : A → F) :
   188	    MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u)

   190	  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
   191	  | C a => simp
   192	  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
   193	  | mul_X p i hp => cases i <;> simp [hp]

   195	/-- Split the full joint uniform point into the base point and scalar point.

   197	def scalarBaseQuestionEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   198	    ((Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P) × (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) ≃
   199	      ExtendedPointQuestion P :=
   200	  (((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).piCongrLeft fun _ => PauliScalar P).trans
   201	    (Equiv.sumPiEquivProdPi fun _ : Fin P.m ⊕ Fin P.m => PauliScalar P)).prodCongr
   202	      (finTwoArrowEquiv (PauliScalar P))

   209	  apply (directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv P).injective

   211	  apply Prod.ext

   213	      simp [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv, scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv, projX, projZ,

   219	/-- Evaluation of the nested polynomial is exactly the actual singleton readout,
   220	including the canonical field transport and all four coordinate blocks. -/
   221	theorem scalarPolynomial_eval (P : AdmissibleParams)
   222	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd)
   223	    (u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) :
   224	    MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) (scalarPolynomial P g)) =
   225	      extendedPolynomialRead P (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)) g := by
   226	  rw [scalarPolynomial, eval_sumRingEquiv, MvPolynomial.eval_rename,
   227	    MvPolynomial.eval_map]

   229	  rw [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv_direct]
   230	  have h := (MvPolynomial.eval₂_comp (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom
   231	      (fun i => (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm
   232	        (Sum.elim v u (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m i))) (g (0 : Fin 1)).1).symm
   233	  change MvPolynomial.eval₂ (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom
   234	      (fun i => extendedDirectScalarEquiv P ((extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm
   235	        (Sum.elim v u (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m i)))) (g (0 : Fin 1)).1 = _ at h
   236	  simp only [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h

   239	/-- Exact partial evaluation for either block order. This is the coefficient
   240	specialization used in `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   241	theorem blockCoefficientPolynomial_eval (P : AdmissibleParams)
   242	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool)
   243	    (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   244	    MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   245	      (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse)) =
   246	    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => Sum.elim x z
   247	      (((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   248	        (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)) i))
   249	      ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a) := by
   250	  rw [blockCoefficientPolynomial, eval_sumRingEquiv, MvPolynomial.eval_rename]

   253	/-- Joint sample equivalence for the fiber calculation: the first input block
   254	is fixed and the second varies. Reversal exchanges both the point blocks and
   255	the scalar coefficients, so its ordered product is `ZX`. This supports the
   256	two orders in `eq:qld-g-42/43` and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   257	def fiberQuestionEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) (reverse : Bool) :
   258	    (((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) ×
   259	      (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) ≃ ExtendedPointQuestion P :=
   260	  (if reverse then Equiv.refl _ else Equiv.prodComm _ _).prodCongr
   261	    ((finTwoArrowEquiv (PauliScalar P)).trans
   262	      (if reverse then Equiv.prodComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _))
   263	
   264	/-- For a scalar-linear outcome, its actual readout equals the two specialized
   265	coefficient polynomials in the corresponding block and scalar order. This is
   266	an exact identity, with no field-size condition; support for `eq:qld-g-48`
   267	and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   268	theorem scalarPolynomial_linear_read_fiber (P : AdmissibleParams)
   269	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd)
   270	    (hg : ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P),
   271	      scalarPolynomial P g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
   272	        MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   273	    (reverse : Bool) (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) :
   274	    extendedPolynomialRead P (fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v)) g =
   275	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   276	        (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 1 else 0) 1)
   277	          reverse)) +
   278	      v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   279	        (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 0 else 1) 1)
   280	          reverse)) := by
   281	  obtain ⟨r, t, hg⟩ := hg
   282	  let u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P := fun i => Sum.elim x z
   283	    (((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   284	      (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)) i)
   285	  let v' : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P := if reverse then ![v 1, v 0] else v
   286	  have heq : scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v') =
   287	      fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v) := by
   288	    cases reverse <;> simp [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv, fiberQuestionEquiv, u, v',
   289	      Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply]
   290	  rw [← heq, ← scalarPolynomial_eval, hg]
   291	  simp_rw [blockCoefficientPolynomial_eval, hg]
   292	  have h01 : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 := by
   293	    intro h
   294	    simpa using congrArg (fun e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => e 0) h
   295	  simp only [map_add, map_mul, MvPolynomial.map_C, MvPolynomial.map_X,
   296	    MvPolynomial.eval_C, MvPolynomial.eval_X]
   297	  cases reverse <;>
   298	    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, MvPolynomial.coeff_add,
   299	      MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, h01, Ne.symm h01,
   300	      ↓reduceIte, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
   301	  · change MvPolynomial.eval u r * v 0 + MvPolynomial.eval u t * v 1 =
   302	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval u r + v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval u t
   303	    ring
   304	  · change MvPolynomial.eval u r * v 1 + MvPolynomial.eval u t * v 0 =
   305	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval u t + v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval u r
   306	    ring

   343	  apply (MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv (PauliScalar P) (Fin P.m) (Fin P.m)).injective

   351	      (eqv ∘ (fun i => eqv.symm (.inr i))) r)

   355	    (f h : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (PauliScalar P)) :
   356	    MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv _ _ _
   357	      (MvPolynomial.rename (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m) (combinePoly f h)) =
   358	    MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.rename
   359	      (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inl i)) f) * MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 2) +
   360	    MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.rename
   361	      (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inr i)) h) * MvPolynomial.X 1 := by

   386	theorem exists_polyPair_of_scalar_separated (P : AdmissibleParams)
   387	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd)
   388	    (hlin : ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P),

   412	  change t = MvPolynomial.rename (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inr i)) h.1 at hh

     4	/-!
     5	# Common exceptional fibers for polynomial coefficients
     6	
     7	A nonconstant polynomial in one block, with polynomial coefficients in a
     8	second block, has one nonzero nonconstant coefficient. Its zero set controls
     9	all exceptional specializations simultaneously, independently of the outcome
    10	of a measurement. The weights may depend on the fixed block but not on the
    11	block being averaged.
    12	
    13	## References
    14	
    15	Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1341-1358`,
    16	especially `eq:qld-g-2`; support for blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

    28	variable {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]
