    30	private theorem exists_nonconstant_coeff {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ}
    31	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r) :
    32	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
    33	  classical
    34	  by_contra! h
    35	  apply hp
    36	  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
    37	  ext e
    38	  by_cases he : e = 0
    39	  · simp [he]
    40	  · simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he, h e he]
    41	
    42	/-- A single coefficient defines the exceptional slices for every field
    43	outcome. Outside its zero set, every fiber has probability at most `D/q`;
    44	the exceptional set itself has probability at most `C/q`. Both degree
    45	conditions concern the displayed polynomial, not an assumed collision law.
    46	This is the common-set argument following `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting
    47	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    48	theorem exists_common_exceptional_coefficient {n k C D : ℕ}
    49	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
    50	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    51	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D) :
    52	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 ∧
    53	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F))
    54	        (fun z => if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
    55	          (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F ∧
    56	      ∀ z : Fin k → F, MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) ≠ 0 → ∀ b : F,
    57	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    58	          (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    59	            then 1 else 0) ≤ (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F := by
    60	  obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := exists_nonconstant_coeff p hp
    61	  refine ⟨e, he, hc, ?_, ?_⟩
    62	  · simpa using avg_eval_eq_le (p.coeff e) 0 hc (hcoeff e) (by simp)
    63	  · intro z hz b
    64	    have hne : MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p ≠ MvPolynomial.C b := by
    65	      intro h
    66	      apply hz
    67	      have h' := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff e) h
    68	      simpa [MvPolynomial.coeff_map, MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he] using h'
    69	    have hd : (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p).totalDegree ≤ D :=
    70	      (Finset.sup_mono (MvPolynomial.support_map_subset _ _)).trans hdegree
    71	    simpa using avg_eval_eq_le _ (MvPolynomial.C b) hne hd (by simp)
    72	
    73	/-- Summing all nonnegative outcome weights before averaging exceptional
    74	slices avoids an outcome-cardinality factor. The weights may depend on `z`
    75	and their sum is the same mass `M` at every `z`. This is the weighted fiber
    76	calculation in `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    77	theorem avg_weighted_fiber_le {n k C D : ℕ}
    78	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
    79	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    80	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D)
    81	    (w : (Fin k → F) → F → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    82	    (hw : ∀ z b, 0 ≤ w z b) (hsum : ∀ z, ∑ b, w z b = M) :
    83	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z => ∑ b : F,
    84	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    85	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    86	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤ ((C + D : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
    87	  classical
    88	  obtain ⟨e, _, _, hbad, hgood⟩ :=
    89	    exists_common_exceptional_coefficient p hp hcoeff hdegree
    90	  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by
    91	    rw [← hsum (fun _ => 0)]
    92	    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => hw _ b
    93	  have hpoint (z : Fin k → F) :
    94	      (∑ b : F, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    95	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    96	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤
    97	      (if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * M +
    98	        (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
    99	    by_cases hz : MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0
   100	    · simp only [hz, if_true, one_mul]
   101	      apply le_trans (b := M)
   102	      · rw [← hsum z]
   103	        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   104	        intro b _
   105	        apply le_trans (b := 1 * w z b)
   106	        · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hw z b)
   107	          apply avgOver_uniform_le_const
   108	          intro x
   109	          split_ifs <;> norm_num
   110	        · rw [one_mul]
   111	      · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hM)
   112	    · simp only [hz, if_false, zero_mul, zero_add]
   113	      rw [← hsum z, Finset.mul_sum]
   114	      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ =>
   115	        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hgood z hz b) (hw z b)
   116	  calc
   117	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   118	        (if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * M +
   119	          (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M) := avgOver_mono _ _ _ hpoint
   120	    _ ≤ (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M + (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
   121	      rw [avgOver_add, avgOver_mul_const, avgOver_uniform_const]
   122	      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbad hM) le_rfl
   123	    _ = _ := by push_cast; ring

   127	private theorem avg_diagonalIndicator_linear_le
   128	    (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   129	    (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   130	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   131	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t))) ≤
   132	      (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   133	        stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t * X.effect r * Z.effect t) := by
   134	  classical
   135	  let w (bc : F × F) : ℝ := stateQForm ψ
   136	    (Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2)
   137	  have hw (bc : F × F) : 0 ≤ w bc :=
   138	    stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).1 bc)
   139	  have hsum : ∑ bc, w bc = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   140	    rw [← stateQForm_one ψ, ← (pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).2,
   141	      stateQForm_finset_sum]
   142	    rfl
   143	  have hexpand (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   144	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) =
   145	      ∑ bc : F × F, (if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t
   146	        then 1 else 0) * w bc := by
   147	    rw [diagonalIndicator, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   148	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   149	    intro bc _
   150	    split_ifs <;> simp [w, stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
   151	  have hcollision (bc : F × F) :
   152	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   153	        if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
   154	        if bc = (r, t) then 1 else (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
   155	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   156	    exact affine_collision_average bc (r, t)
   157	  simp_rw [hexpand, avgOver_sum, avgOver_mul_const, hcollision]
   158	  calc
   159	    _ ≤ ∑ bc : F × F, ((Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ +
   160	        if bc = (r, t) then 1 else 0) * w bc := by
   161	      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   162	      intro bc _
   163	      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hw bc)
   164	      split_ifs <;> simp
   165	    _ = _ := by
   166	      simp_rw [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   167	      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hsum]
   168	      simp [w]

   170	private theorem avg_orderedIndicator_linear_le
   171	    (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X)
   172	    (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   173	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   174	      ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1)
   175	        (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2) ≤
   176	      2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 + stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t) := by
   177	  have hexc : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   178	      (fun v => if v 1 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) =
   179	        (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   180	    change avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   181	      (fun v => if ((finTwoArrowEquiv F) v).2 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) = _
   182	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   183	    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   184	    rw [avgOver_uniform_snd (fun β : F => if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0)]
   185	    simp [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]
   186	  have hdrop : stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t * X.effect r * Z.effect t) ≤

   188	    apply quadratic_form_mono
   189	    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, measurement_effect_hermitian, mul_one,

   191	      star_left_conjugate_le_conjugate (measurement_effect_le_one X r) (Z.effect t)
   192	  have havg := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) _ _ (fun v =>
   193	    le_trans (le_abs_self _) (abs_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_sub_diagonal_le
   194	      X Z hX hZ (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t) ψ))
   195	  rw [avgOver_sub, hexc] at havg
   196	  have hdiag := avg_diagonalIndicator_linear_le X Z hZ r t ψ
   197	  linarith
   198	
   199	/-- The wrong-variable coefficient is concentrated only after the middle
   200	contraction has been removed. The outer measurement depends solely on the
   201	fixed block `z`; `X` depends solely on the varying block `x`. For the other
   202	class interchange `X,Z` and the two blocks. The vector is arbitrary and
   203	need not be normalized. This proves the local norm bound behind
   204	`eq:qld-g-prime-xpt-bound` and its reversed-order counterpart, supporting
   205	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   206	theorem avg_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_nonconstant {n k C D : ℕ}
   207	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
   208	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
   209	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D)
   210	    (r : (Fin n → F) → (Fin k → F) → F)
   211	    (X : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   212	    (Z : (Fin k → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   213	    (hX : ∀ x, Measurement.IsProjective (X x))
   214	    (hZ : ∀ z, Measurement.IsProjective (Z z)) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   215	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   216	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun x =>
   217	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   218	          ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X x) (Z z) (v 0) (v 1)
   219	            (v 0 * r x z + v 1 *
   220	              MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))) ψ‖ ^ 2))) ≤
   221	      ((C + D + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   222	  classical
   223	  let w (z : Fin k → F) (b : F) := stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect b)
   224	  have hsum (z : Fin k → F) : ∑ b, w z b = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   225	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, (Z z).sum_eq_one, stateQForm_one]
   226	  have hfiber := avg_weighted_fiber_le p hp hcoeff hdegree w (‖ψ‖ ^ 2)
   227	    (fun z b => stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((Z z).pos b)) hsum
   228	  have heval (z : Fin k → F) (x : Fin n → F) :
   229	      stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect
   230	        (MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))) =
   231	      ∑ b : F, (if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
   232	        then 1 else 0) * w z b := by
   233	    simp [w]
   234	  calc
   235	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   236	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun x =>
   237	          2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   238	          stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect
   239	            (MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))))) := by
   240	      apply avgOver_mono
   241	      intro z
   242	      apply avgOver_mono
   243	      intro x
   244	      exact avg_orderedIndicator_linear_le (X x) (Z z) (hX x) (hZ z) _ _ ψ
   245	    _ = 2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   246	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z => ∑ b : F,
   247	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   248	            (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
   249	              then 1 else 0) * w z b) := by
   250	      simp_rw [heval, avgOver_add, avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_sum, avgOver_mul_const]
   251	    _ ≤ 2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   252	        ((C + D : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := add_le_add le_rfl hfiber
   253	    _ = _ := by push_cast; ring

     5	/-!
     6	# Indicator-weighted ordered projectors
     7	
     8	This module proves the local norm calculation in `eq:qld-g-prime`. The state
     9	vector is not assumed normalized: its squared norm controls the exceptional
    10	coefficient, so the estimate can be summed over all polynomial outcomes.
    11	The measurements act on an arbitrary finite space, which includes either
    12	player's placed expanded measurements.
    13	
    14	The coefficient-polynomial argument also bounds mass outside the scalar-linear
    15	image, with its actual ordered-correlation error displayed in the conclusion.
    16	These are auxiliary estimates, not the global polynomial-pair construction.
    17	The remaining block-separation and construction obligations are recorded in
    18	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex` and issue #513.
    19	
    20	All proof content, including the private supporting lemmas, is recovered from
    21	the immutable PR296 head cited below. Only the required dependency chain is
    22	retained, with internal lemmas private. Recovery earns no new-proof attribution.
    23	
    24	## References

    45	/-- The ordered product selected by the linear field-answer check in
    46	`eq:qld-g-42`. This is an operator, not an asserted measurement effect. -/
    47	def orderedIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    48	  ∑ bc : F × F, if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    49	
    50	/-- The diagonal sandwich sum in `eq:qld-g-prime`. -/
    51	def diagonalIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    52	  ∑ bc : F × F,
    53	    if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then
    54	      Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    55	
    56	/-- For a nonzero second coefficient, X orthogonality and cancellation in
    57	the field eliminate every off-diagonal term of the ordered Gram operator.
    58	This is the exact local algebra behind `eq:qld-g-prime`; no commutation of
    59	the X and Z measurements is assumed. -/
    60	private theorem orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    61	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0) :
    62	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a =
    63	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a := by
    64	  classical
    65	  unfold orderedIndicator diagonalIndicator
    66	  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    67	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun bc _ => ?_
    68	  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single bc]
    69	  · by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    70	    · simp only [if_pos h, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, measurement_effect_hermitian]
    71	      rw [mul_assoc (Z.effect bc.2), ← mul_assoc (X.effect bc.1),
    72	        (hX bc.1).isIdempotentElem.eq, ← mul_assoc]
    73	    · simp [h]
    74	  · intro bc' _ hne
    75	    by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    76	    · by_cases h' : α * bc'.1 + β * bc'.2 = a
    77	      · have hb : bc.1 ≠ bc'.1 := by
    78	          intro hb
    79	          have hc : bc.2 = bc'.2 := mul_left_cancel₀ hβ (by
    80	            apply add_left_cancel (a := α * bc.1)
    81	            simpa only [hb] using h.trans h'.symm)
    82	          exact hne (Prod.ext hb hc).symm
    83	        simp only [if_pos h, if_pos h', Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    84	          measurement_effect_hermitian]
    85	        calc
    86	          Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * (X.effect bc'.1 * Z.effect bc'.2) =
    87	              Z.effect bc.2 * (X.effect bc.1 * X.effect bc'.1) * Z.effect bc'.2 := by
    88	            simp only [mul_assoc]
    89	          _ = 0 := by rw [projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero X hX hb]; simp
    90	      · simp [h']
    91	    · simp [h]
    92	  · simp

    94	/-- The squared state norm of the ordered indicator equals its diagonal
    95	sandwich quadratic form when the second coefficient is nonzero. -/
    96	private theorem orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    97	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    98	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    99	    ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 =
   100	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) := by
   101	  rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq,
   102	    orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   103	  rfl

   105	/-- The diagonal indicator is a positive contraction, since it selects
   106	effects from the complete sandwich POVM. -/
   107	private theorem diagonalIndicator_bounds (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   108	    (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   109	    0 ≤ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ∧ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   110	  obtain ⟨hpos, hsum⟩ := pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ
   111	  change (∀ bc : F × F, 0 ≤ Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) at hpos
   112	  change (∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) = 1 at hsum
   113	  constructor
   114	  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun bc _ => by
   115	      split_ifs
   116	      · exact hpos bc
   117	      · exact le_refl 0
   118	  · calc
   119	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤
   120	          ∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 := by
   121	        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun bc _ => ?_
   122	        split_ifs
   123	        · exact le_refl _
   124	        · exact hpos bc
   125	      _ = 1 := hsum

   127	/-- At the exceptional coefficient zero, completeness of Z leaves a
   128	coarse-grained X projection. This includes zero first coefficient. -/
   129	private theorem orderedIndicator_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α a : F) :
   130	    orderedIndicator X Z α 0 a = (X.postprocess (fun b => α * b)).effect a := by
   131	  unfold orderedIndicator
   132	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
   133	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   134	  by_cases h : α * b = a
   135	  · simp only [zero_mul, add_zero, h, if_true]
   136	    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Z.sum_eq_one, mul_one]
   137	  · simp [h]

   139	/-- Every linear-answer ordered indicator is a contraction. For nonzero
   140	second coefficient this follows from the diagonal identity; at zero it
   141	follows from completeness and projective postprocessing. -/
   142	theorem orderedIndicator_gram_le_one (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   143	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   144	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   145	  by_cases hβ : β = 0
   146	  · subst β
   147	    rw [orderedIndicator_zero, measurement_effect_hermitian,
   148	      (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective X hX (fun b => α * b) a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   149	    exact measurement_effect_le_one _ _
   150	  · rw [orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   151	    exact (diagonalIndicator_bounds X Z hZ α β a).2

   153	/-- The pointwise error in `eq:qld-g-prime` is supported on the zero second
   154	coefficient and bounded by the squared norm of the actual state vector. -/
   155	theorem abs_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_sub_diagonal_le (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   156	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   157	    (α β a : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   158	    |‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 -
   159	        stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a)| ≤
   160	      if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0 := by
   161	  by_cases hβ : β = 0
   162	  · rw [if_pos hβ]
   163	    have hA0 := sq_nonneg ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖
   164	    have hA1 : ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   165	      rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq, ← stateQForm_one ψ]
   166	      exact quadratic_form_mono (orderedIndicator_gram_le_one X Z hX hZ α β a) ψ
   167	    have hD := diagonalIndicator_bounds X Z hZ α β a
   168	    have hD0 := stateQForm_nonneg ψ hD.1
   169	    have hD1 : stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) ≤ ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   170	      rw [← stateQForm_one ψ]
   171	      exact quadratic_form_mono hD.2 ψ
   172	    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
   173	  · rw [if_neg hβ, orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ ψ]
   174	    simp

   176	/-- Completeness and projectivity preserve total squared state mass. This is
   177	the normalization used after summing `eq:qld-g-prime` over polynomial labels. -/
   178	theorem sum_projective_state_norm_sq {Γ : Type*} [Fintype Γ]

   182	  simp_rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq, measurement_effect_hermitian,

   184	  change (∑ g : Γ, stateQForm ψ (S.effect g)) = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2
   185	  rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, S.sum_eq_one, stateQForm_one]

   187	/-- A polynomial not of the form `alpha * u + beta * v` has a nonzero
   188	coefficient outside those two monomials. Applied over the ring of base-point
   189	polynomials, this chooses one coefficient independently of both measurement
   190	outcomes in the argument following `eq:qld-g-prime`. -/
   191	private theorem exists_nonzero_nonlinear_coeff {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
   192	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R)
   193	    (hp : ¬ ∃ u v : R, p = MvPolynomial.C u * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
   194	      MvPolynomial.C v * MvPolynomial.X 1) :
   195	    ∃ e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, e ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1 ∧ e ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 ∧
   196	      p.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
   197	  classical
   198	  have h01 : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 := by
   199	    intro h
   200	    simpa using congrArg (fun e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => e 0) h
   201	  by_contra! h
   202	  apply hp
   203	  refine ⟨p.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 1), p.coeff (Finsupp.single 1 1), ?_⟩
   204	  ext e
   205	  by_cases h0 : e = Finsupp.single 0 1
   206	  · subst e
   207	    simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, Ne.symm h01]
   208	  · by_cases h1 : e = Finsupp.single 1 1
   209	    · subst e
   210	      simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, h01]
   211	    · simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, Ne.symm h0, Ne.symm h1,
   212	        h e h0 h1]

   218	private theorem specialization_ne_linear_of_coeff {n : ℕ}
   219	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F)) (e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)

   222	    MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p ≠
   223	      MvPolynomial.C b * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X 1 := by
   224	  intro h
   225	  apply hu

   249	private theorem avg_specialization_eq_linear_le_of_coeff {n : ℕ}
   250	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F)) (e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)

   269	/-- The first polynomial-image estimate for the diagonal sandwich, with
   270	explicit degrees of the scalar polynomial and its base-point coefficients.
   271	A single nonzero nonlinear coefficient supplies a common exceptional set for
   272	all outcomes. Neither a uniform-collision premise nor an outcome-count loss
   273	occurs. The nested polynomial ring is the coefficient expansion used at paper
   274	lines 1311--1316; this theorem does not assert the later block-separation step. -/
   275	private theorem avg_diagonalIndicator_le_of_not_linear {n : ℕ}
   276	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F))
   277	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r s : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F,
   278	      p = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C s * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   279	    (X Z : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   280	    (hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u)) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   281	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   282	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   283	        stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   284	          (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p))))) ≤
   285	      ((p.support.sup fun e => (p.coeff e).totalDegree) + max 1 p.totalDegree : ℕ) /
   286	        (Fintype.card F : ℝ) * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   287	  classical
   288	  obtain ⟨e, he0, he1, he⟩ := exists_nonzero_nonlinear_coeff p hp
   289	  let D : ℕ := p.support.sup fun e => (p.coeff e).totalDegree
   290	  let E : ℝ := (max 1 p.totalDegree : ℕ) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ)
   291	  let w (u : Fin n → F) (bc : F × F) : ℝ :=
   292	    stateQForm ψ ((Z u).effect bc.2 * (X u).effect bc.1 * (Z u).effect bc.2)
   293	  let f (u : Fin n → F) (v : Fin 2 → F) : F :=
   294	    MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p)
   295	  have hw (u : Fin n → F) (bc : F × F) : 0 ≤ w u bc :=
   296	    stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement (X u) (Z u) (hZ u)).1 bc)
   297	  have hsum (u : Fin n → F) : ∑ bc : F × F, w u bc = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   298	    rw [← stateQForm_one ψ,
   299	      ← (pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement (X u) (Z u) (hZ u)).2, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   300	    rfl
   301	  have hexpand (u : Fin n → F) (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   302	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1) (f u v)) =
   303	        ∑ bc : F × F, (if f u v = v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 then 1 else 0) * w u bc := by
   304	    rw [diagonalIndicator, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   305	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun bc _ => ?_
   306	    by_cases h : f u v = v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2
   307	    · simp [h, w]
   308	    · simp [Ne.symm h, h, stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
   309	  have hgood (u : Fin n → F) (hu : MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) ≠ 0) :
   310	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   311	        stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1) (f u v))) ≤
   312	        E * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   313	    simp_rw [hexpand, avgOver_sum, avgOver_mul_const]
   314	    rw [← hsum u, Finset.mul_sum]
   315	    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun bc _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
   316	      (avg_specialization_eq_linear_le_of_coeff p e he0 he1 u hu bc.1 bc.2) (hw u bc)
   317	  have hpoint (u : Fin n → F) :
   318	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   319	        stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1) (f u v))) ≤
   320	        (if MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 + E * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   321	    by_cases hu : MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) = 0
   322	    · simp only [hu, if_true, one_mul]
   323	      apply le_trans (b := ‖ψ‖ ^ 2)
   324	      · apply avgOver_uniform_le_const
   325	        intro v
   326	        rw [← stateQForm_one ψ]
   327	        exact quadratic_form_mono (diagonalIndicator_bounds (X u) (Z u) (hZ u) _ _ _).2 ψ
   328	      · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (sq_nonneg _))
   329	    · simpa only [hu, if_false, zero_mul, zero_add] using hgood u hu
   330	  have hbad : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   331	      (fun u => if MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
   332	        (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F := by
   333	    simpa using avg_eval_eq_le (p.coeff e) 0 he
   334	      (Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => (p.coeff j).totalDegree)
   335	        (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr he)) (by simp)
   336	  calc
   337	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   338	        (if MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 + E * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2) :=
   339	      avgOver_mono _ _ _ hpoint

   341	      rw [avgOver_add, avgOver_mul_const, avgOver_uniform_const]
   342	      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbad (sq_nonneg _)) le_rfl
   343	    _ = _ := by dsimp [D, E]; push_cast; ring

   345	/-- Adding the genuinely uniform zero-coefficient contribution gives the
   346	ordered-projector estimate for a polynomial outside the scalar-linear image.
   347	The right side retains the squared norm of the unnormalized state. -/
   348	private theorem avg_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_not_linear {n : ℕ}
   349	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F))
   350	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r s : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F,
   351	      p = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C s * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   352	    (X Z : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   353	    (hX : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (X u))
   354	    (hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u)) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   355	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   356	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   357	        ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   358	          (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p))) ψ‖ ^ 2)) ≤
   359	      ((p.support.sup fun e => (p.coeff e).totalDegree) + max 1 p.totalDegree + 1 : ℕ) /
   360	        (Fintype.card F : ℝ) * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   361	  let f (u : Fin n → F) (v : Fin 2 → F) : F :=
   362	    MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p)
   363	  have hexc : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))

   371	    simp [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]

   375	          stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1) (f u v)) +

   387	          stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1) (f u v)))) +

   398	private theorem avg_sum_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_not_linear {n : ℕ} {Γ : Type*}
   399	    (s : Finset Γ) (p : Γ → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F))

   404	    (hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u)) (ψ : Γ → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :

   410	        (((p g).support.sup fun e => ((p g).coeff e).totalDegree) +
   411	          max 1 (p g).totalDegree + 1 : ℕ) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ) * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 := by
   412	  simp_rw [avgOver_finset_sum]
   413	  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun g hg =>
   414	    avg_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_not_linear (p g) (hp g hg) X Z hX hZ (ψ g)

   421	theorem sum_mass_le_residual_add_image {Γ : Type*} (s : Finset Γ)
   422	    (ψ A : Γ → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   423	    ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤
   424	      2 * ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g - A g‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ∑ g ∈ s, ‖A g‖ ^ 2 := by
   425	  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   426	  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun g _ => ?_
   427	  have htriangle := norm_add_le (ψ g - A g) (A g)

   437	    (s : Finset Γ) (p : Γ → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F))
   438	    (hp : ∀ g ∈ s, ¬ ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F,

   441	    (hX : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (X u))
   442	    (hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u)) (ψ : Γ → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   443	    ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤
   444	      2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   445	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s,
   446	          ‖ψ g - applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   447	            (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) (p g)))) (ψ g)‖ ^ 2)) +
   448	      2 * ∑ g ∈ s,
   449	        (((p g).support.sup fun e => ((p g).coeff e).totalDegree) +
   450	          max 1 (p g).totalDegree + 1 : ℕ) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ) * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 := by

   457	    sum_mass_le_residual_add_image s ψ (A u v)
   458	  have havg := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) _ _ fun u =>
   459	    avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) _ _ (hpoint u)
   460	  simp only [avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_add, avgOver_const_mul] at havg
   461	  have hnorm := avg_sum_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_not_linear s p hp X Z hX hZ ψ
   462	  change ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   463	    (fun u => avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   464	      (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g - A u v g‖ ^ 2)) + _
   465	  change avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   466	    (fun u => avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   467	      (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s, ‖A u v g‖ ^ 2)) ≤ _ at hnorm
   468	  linarith

    26	/-- The retained point mismatch is the squared norm of the incorrect point
    27	projection on the actual vector `R_g psiHat`, averaged over the point. -/
    28	def retainedPointMismatch {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    29	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : Placement)
    30	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    31	    (W : PauliKind) : ℝ :=
    32	  avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun x =>
    33	    ∑ pair : PolyPair P, ‖applyOperatorToState
    34	      (1 - S.place p2 ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side W x).effect (evalAt W x pair)))
    35	      (applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 (R.effect (directCombinedEmbedding P pair)))
    36	        S.psiHat)‖ ^ 2)

    38	/-- Both retained point mismatches are bounded by their appropriate full
    39	ordered error. The wrong point projection is the outer factor: `XZ` for X,
    40	`ZX` for Z. Normalization is used only after summing the actual vector masses,
    41	so there is no outcome-cardinality factor. -/
    42	theorem retainedPointMismatch_le_ordered_error {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    43	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopposite : p1.IsOpposite p2)
    44	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))

/-!
# Geometry for the directly indexed low-degree game

This module defines the parameters, line carrier, and line-point distributions
for the directly indexed low-degree game.

## References

The line-point distributions originate in
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-272`.
The directly indexed repair is documented in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open MIPStarRE.LDT
open MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
open MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-- Parameters for the directly indexed low-degree game.  Unlike `LdParams`,
this directly indexed line-space construction has no divisibility field: its coordinate index is
sampled from `Fin m` rather than encoded by fibers of `chiIndex`.

This is the direct-index repair described in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`; it is not a second
definition of the source verifier game. -/
structure DirectLdParams where
  q : ℕ
  m : ℕ
  d : ℕ
  k : ℕ
  hm : 1 ≤ m
  hd : 1 ≤ d
  hk : 1 ≤ k
  hq : IsAdmissibleSize q

/-- The canonical scalar model for directly indexed parameters. -/
noncomputable def DirectLdParams.model (D : DirectLdParams) : FixedFieldModel D.q :=
  fixedFieldModel D.q D.hq

/-- The scalar field of a directly indexed low-degree game. -/
abbrev DirectScalarQ (D : DirectLdParams) := D.model.K

/-- The first coordinate, available because directly indexed dimensions are
positive. -/
def DirectLdParams.firstIndex (D : DirectLdParams) : Fin D.m :=
  ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one D.hm⟩

instance (D : DirectLdParams) : Nonempty (Fin D.m) := ⟨D.firstIndex⟩

/-- The direct game used at the extended dimension of the combining map.  Its
field, degree, and simultaneity parameters are inherited from `P`, while its
dimension is `2 * P.m + 2`; no divisibility assertion is introduced.

The construction has dimension `2 * P.m + 2` without requiring
`2 * P.m + 2 ∣ P.q`; it supplies the directly indexed line and coordinate
spaces used in the dimension-extension argument of blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`.
-/
def AdmissibleParams.extendedDirectLd (P : AdmissibleParams) : DirectLdParams where
  q := P.q
  m := 2 * P.m + 2
  d := P.d
  k := 1
  hm := by omega
  hd := P.hd
  hk := by decide
  hq := P.hq

/-- A common random sample for the directly indexed question distribution.
The point, coordinate index, and unrestricted direction are mutually uniform. -/
structure DirectLdSpace (D : DirectLdParams) where
  point : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D
  index : Fin D.m
  direction : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

instance (D : DirectLdParams) : Nonempty (DirectLdSpace D) :=
  ⟨⟨0, D.firstIndex, 0⟩⟩

/-- Decompose a direct sample into its point and the remaining independent
coordinates. -/
def directLdSpacePointEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
    DirectLdSpace D ≃
      (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) ×
        (Fin D.m × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) where
  toFun sample := (sample.point, sample.index, sample.direction)
  invFun sample := ⟨sample.1, sample.2.1, sample.2.2⟩
  left_inv sample := by cases sample; rfl
  right_inv sample := by cases sample; rfl

/-- Decompose a direct sample into its stored index and the remaining
independent coordinates. -/
def directLdSpaceIndexEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
    DirectLdSpace D ≃
      Fin D.m ×
        ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) ×
          (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) where
  toFun sample := (sample.index, sample.point, sample.direction)
  invFun sample := ⟨sample.2.1, sample.1, sample.2.2⟩
  left_inv sample := by cases sample; rfl
  right_inv sample := by cases sample; rfl

/-- Compatibility name for the index-first direct-sample decomposition. -/
abbrev directLdSpaceIndexSplitEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
    DirectLdSpace D ≃
      Fin D.m × ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) :=
  directLdSpaceIndexEquiv D

/-- Zero the coordinates preceding the directly sampled prefix index. -/
def directPrefixProjection {D : DirectLdParams} (i : Fin D.m)
    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D :=
  fun j => if j.val < i.val then 0 else v j

/-- Zeroing the coordinates preceding a prefix index is idempotent: the
coordinates it leaves unchanged are exactly those it does not zero. -/

/-!
# Simultaneous polynomial measurements for the direct low-degree game

This module applies the quantum soundness theorem of the low individual
degree test to each coordinate of a projective strategy for the directly
indexed low-degree game, transports the Schwartz--Zippel collision estimate
to the direct polynomial representatives, and, for simultaneity parameter
`1`, obtains the polynomial-tuple conclusion of `lem:ld-soundness` from the
coordinate conclusions.

## The simultaneity obstruction

For simultaneity parameter `k ≥ 2` the coordinate conclusions alone do not
determine simultaneous polynomial measurements, so no palindromic combination
of the coordinate measurements can be consistent with a joint point
measurement in general.  Let `q = 2^s`, let the degree be `1`, and let Bob
measure the univariate polynomials `g = g₀ + g₁ x` once in the standard basis
`|g⟩` and once in the Fourier basis attached to the symmetric pairing
`⟨h, g⟩ = h₀ g₁ + h₁ g₀`.  In characteristic two every evaluation functional
`h ↦ h(u)` is represented by an isotropic vector of this pairing, so at every
point `u` the value-level coarse-grainings `Q^{1,u}_{[a]}` (Fourier basis) and
`Q^{2,u}_{[b]}` (standard basis) commute, and on the maximally entangled state
Alice may answer point questions with the joint projective measurement
`P^u_{a,b} = (Q^{1,u}_{[a]} Q^{2,u}_{[b]})ᵀ`.  All coordinate consistencies of
`lem:ld-soundness` then hold with defect `0` and distinct polynomials collide
at a uniform point with probability `1 / q`, but the sandwiched POVM has
`∑_{g₂(u) = b} |g₂⟩⟨g₂| Q^{1,u}_{[a]} |g₂⟩⟨g₂| = q⁻¹ Q^{2,u}_{[b]}`, whose
consistency defect against `P^u` is `1 - 1/q`; more strongly, every
polynomial-pair POVM on Bob's side has defect at least `1 - 2/q` against
`P^u`.  No bound of the form `C k √(δ + m d / q)` holds for a universal `C`.
The source obtains the general case not coordinatewise but by the combining
reduction of Theorem 4.43 in the NEEXP paper, which applies the `k = 1`
theorem once, in dimension `m + k`, to a combined strategy; that reduction is
not formalized here.  The two-measurement pasting estimate (Fact 4.35 there)
does not apply either, since it evaluates the two coordinates at
independently sampled points while the low-degree game evaluates all
coordinates at one point.  The counterexample and the resulting formal
status are recorded in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-simultaneous-sandwich.tex`.

## References

/-! ## Direct polynomial collision estimate -/

/-- Two distinct direct polynomial representatives agree at a uniformly
sampled direct point with probability at most `m d / q`.

This is the Schwartz--Zippel estimate `polynomialAgreement_avg_le_mdq` of the
low individual degree test, read through the polynomial and point
identifications of the direct low-degree game; it is the collision
hypothesis of blueprint `lem:ld-sandwich`
(paper `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-501`). -/
theorem directPolynomialAgreement_avg_le_mdq (D : DirectLdParams)
    (g g' : PolyIndex D.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d) (hneq : g ≠ g') :
    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
        (fun u => if MvPolynomial.eval u g.1 = MvPolynomial.eval u g'.1 then
          (1 : Error) else 0) ≤
      (D.m * D.d : Error) / D.q := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  let gLdt := directPolyEquivPolynomial D g
  let g'Ldt := directPolyEquivPolynomial D g'
  have hneqLdt : gLdt ≠ g'Ldt := by
    intro heq
    exact hneq ((directPolyEquivPolynomial D).injective heq)
  calc
    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
        (fun u => if MvPolynomial.eval u g.1 = MvPolynomial.eval u g'.1 then
          (1 : Error) else 0) =
      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
        (fun u => if gLdt (directPointEquiv D u) =
          g'Ldt (directPointEquiv D u) then (1 : Error) else 0) := by
            apply avgOver_congr
            intro u
            simp only [gLdt, g'Ldt, directPolyEquivPolynomial_apply]
            exact if_congr
              ((directScalarEquiv D).injective.eq_iff.symm) rfl rfl
    _ = avgOver (uniformDistribution (Point D.toLDTParameters))
        (fun u : Point D.toLDTParameters =>
          if gLdt u = g'Ldt u then (1 : Error) else 0) := by
      simpa using
        (avgOver_uniform_equiv (directPointEquiv D)
          (fun u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D =>
            if gLdt (directPointEquiv D u) =
              g'Ldt (directPointEquiv D u) then (1 : Error) else 0))
    _ ≤ (D.m * D.d : Error) / D.q :=
      polynomialAgreement_avg_le_mdq D.toLDTParameters gLdt g'Ldt hneqLdt

/-! ## Coordinatewise low individual degree soundness -/

/-- Quantum soundness of the low individual degree test (`thm:main-formal`,
paper `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:180-202`) applied to one
coordinate of a projective strategy for the direct low-degree game.

The coordinate strategy passes the test with failure probability at most
`3 ε`, and the theorem is instantiated at the auxiliary sampling parameter
`directLdAuxParameter D`; both numerical side conditions of the theorem follow
from the positivity of the dimension and of the degree.  Blueprint
`lem:ld-soundness`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`. -/
theorem directCoordinateMainFormal
    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) (ε : Error)
    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    ∃ GA : ProjMeas (Polynomial D.toLDTParameters) S.ιA,
      ∃ GB : ProjMeas (Polynomial D.toLDTParameters) S.ιB,
        ConsRel (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).state
            (uniformDistribution (Point D.toLDTParameters))
            (IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas
              (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).pointMeasurementA)
            (polynomialEvaluationFamily D.toLDTParameters GB.toSubMeas)
            (Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters
              (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε)) ∧
          ConsRel (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).state
            (uniformDistribution (Point D.toLDTParameters))
            (polynomialEvaluationFamily D.toLDTParameters GA.toSubMeas)
            (IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas
              (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).pointMeasurementB)
            (Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters
              (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε)) ∧
          ConsRel (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).state
            (uniformDistribution Unit)
            (constSubMeasFamily GA.toSubMeas)
            (constSubMeasFamily GB.toSubMeas)
            (Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters
              (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε)) := by

    (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r) (3 * ε)

    (directLdAuxParameter_pos D)

/-! ## One-coordinate tuples -/

/-- Relabeling an outcome by a constant tuple over a one-element index set is
selected by the value of the tuple at the unique index. -/
private theorem const_tuple_eq_iff {iota beta : Type*} [Unique iota]
    (v : iota → beta) (b : beta) :
    v = (fun _ => b) ↔ v default = b :=
  funext_iff.trans Unique.forall_iff

/-- The effect of a tuple-relabeled measurement at a constant tuple over a
one-element index set is the effect of the relabeling by the unique
coordinate. -/
private theorem postprocess_effect_const_tuple
    {alpha beta iota d : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha]
    [Fintype beta] [DecidableEq beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    [Unique iota] [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    (M : Quantum.Measurement alpha d) (f : alpha → iota → beta) (b : beta) :
    (M.postprocess f).effect (fun _ => b) =
      (M.postprocess (fun a => f a default)).effect b := by
  simp only [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
  exact Finset.sum_congr
    (Finset.filter_congr fun a _ => const_tuple_eq_iff (f a) b)
    (fun _ _ => rfl)

/-- Reading a measurement as a one-coordinate tuple measurement does not
change its effects. -/
private theorem postprocess_const_tuple_effect_self
    {alpha iota d : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha]
    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota] [Unique iota] [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    (M : Quantum.Measurement alpha d) (p : alpha) :
    (M.postprocess (fun a (_ : iota) => a)).effect (fun _ => p) = M.effect p := by
  rw [postprocess_effect_const_tuple]
  simp only [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.filter_eq',
    Finset.mem_univ, if_true, Finset.sum_singleton]

/-- The polynomial-tuple conclusion of `lem:ld-soundness` for simultaneity
parameter `1`: the coordinate conclusions of the low individual degree
theorem, read as one-coordinate tuples.

The three consistency defects carry the error of `thm:main-formal` at the
auxiliary parameter `directLdAuxParameter D` and pass bound `3 ε`; its
absorption into the error function `deltaLd` is
`exists_directLdTransportConstants`.  For simultaneity parameter at least `2`
the coordinate conclusions do not determine simultaneous polynomial
measurements; see the module docstring and
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-simultaneous-sandwich.tex`.  Blueprint
`lem:ld-soundness`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`. -/
theorem exists_directSimultaneousPolynomialMeasurements_of_k_eq_one
    (D : DirectLdParams) (hk : D.k = 1) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
    (hS : S.IsProjective) (ε : Error) (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) :
    ∃ GA : DirectPolyMeasTuple D S.ιA,
      ∃ GB : DirectPolyMeasTuple D S.ιB,
        consistencyDefect
            (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
            (fun u outcome =>
              heteroKron
                (((S.A (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
                  (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome) 1)
            (fun u outcome =>
              heteroKron 1
                ((GB.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome))
            S.ψ ≤
          Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) ∧
        consistencyDefect
            (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
            (fun u outcome =>
              heteroKron
                ((GA.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome) 1)
            (fun u outcome =>
              heteroKron 1
                (((S.B (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
                  (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome))
            S.ψ ≤
          Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) ∧
        consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
            (fun _ g => heteroKron (GA.effect g) 1)
            (fun _ g => heteroKron 1 (GB.effect g))
            S.ψ ≤
          Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  haveI hU : Unique (Fin D.k) :=
    { default := ⟨0, by omega⟩

+# Global polynomial-pair transport: independent third attempt
+
+## Result
+
+The source theorem `exists_globalPairWitness` remains unproved. Its public
+statement, proof, and blueprint status are unchanged from pinned main

+completion with current-main projective rounding. It does not add a
+conditional producer or duplicate a completed packet. In particular, issue
+#278 was confirmed closed through the primary repository's `gh_common.py`;
+its proof is already present at this base. No duplicate PR is opened.

+## Source and predecessor receipts

+
+## Verified composition and quantifiers
+
+Let A and B be complete measurements on extended polynomials, on the two
+original local spaces, with cross-player consistency defect at most delta.
+For a unit state and delta >= 0, the existing rounding theorem chooses
+projective measurements R_A and R_B on those same spaces. Fix a completion
+pair p, and let c_p send a combined polynomial to its unique pair and every
+other outcome to p.
+
+Postprocessing R_A and R_B by c_p gives projective pair measurements P_A
+and P_B. These measurements are chosen before every finite question,
+intermediate-answer, and final-answer type, probability law mu, readout
+maps l_x and e_x, opposite measurement N_x, and comparison error eta.
+
+For each orientation, if the completed original POVM, first read by l_x and
+then by e_x, has defect at most eta against N_x, the corresponding rounded
+measurement has defect at most
+
+$$
+ R(\delta,\eta)=\delta+\sqrt{220\,\delta^{1/4}}+
+                  2\sqrt{\delta+\eta}.
+$$
+
+The proof applies the existing transport with the single outcome map
+`g => e_x (l_x (c_p g))` and uses `Measurement.postprocess_comp` twice.
+It loses no additional constant and retains the universal quantifiers.
+A polynomial line readout followed by evaluation is one permissible choice
+of the two maps; a point readout is obtained by making the first map the
+identity. The check does not identify a concrete line carrier with the
+source verifier law, nor assert its comparison bound.
+
+This refines the predecessor receipts' projectivity warning: compression
+alone does not preserve projectivity, but same-space projective rounding
+with simultaneous transport is already available once the original
+cross-player polynomial consistency estimate is supplied.

+The verified composition is not a construction from the Pauli strategy.

+# Global polynomial-pair completion: issue #513
+
+## Result and scope
+
+The public statement and proof hole of `exists_globalPairWitness` are unchanged
+from `ae124f8f09ee002444ac5b9711822c0f1daae142`. This packet does not certify
+`lem:qld-4-7`. It recovers the algebraic restriction and projective completion
+from the saved #119 branch and proves two estimates for the completed
+measurement in `Combining/PairCompletion.lean`. The source theorem imports
+that module; no neighboring construction obligation is edited.
+
+Write `c(p) = alpha * p_X(x) + beta * p_Z(z)`. For a measurement `T` on
+extended polynomials, let `R_p = T_{c(p)}` and let `C` be its completion at
+one specified polynomial pair. For any answer map `e`, opposite measurement
+`B`, and vector `psi`, the new pointwise estimate is
+
+\[
+\sum_{a\ne b}\langle\psi|C_{[e=a]}\otimes B_b|\psi\rangle
+\leq \|\psi\|^2-
+\sum_p\langle\psi|R_p\otimes B_{e(p)}|\psi\rangle.
+\]
+
+There is also a uniformly averaged version for question-dependent `e` and
+`B`, stated with `consistencyDefect`. Neither estimate requires projectivity
+or normalization. They follow because completion adds positive operators,
+so it increases diagonal agreement. Completeness expresses the off-diagonal
+overlap as the squared state norm minus diagonal agreement. Thus these
+estimates require a retained-overlap lower bound before they can imply the
+paper's consistency conclusion; that bound is not assumed as a new input.
+
+## Source and provenance
+
+The paper was read before the Lean construction:
+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1267-1404`,
+especially `eq:qld-g-non-separable`, `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`,
+`eq:qld-sgg-mhat-sandwich`, and the final completion paragraph. The matching
+blueprint entry is `lem:qld-4-7`.

+target. The relevant saved proof content is:

+- `cb6d86d8947a940da537543b19d95aebd205e35d`: algebraic recovery,
+  injectivity, restriction, missing-operator identity, and projective
+  completion. These proofs are recovered, not rederived.
+- `3de03d0a`: the combined-outcome evaluation identity. The recovered text

+  Its target theorem still contains the same proof hole.
+- `c9de155f`, saved #295 branch: `PolynomialImageBounds.lean` proves

the resulting error bound into `deltaLd` by
`exists_directLdTransportConstants` at the constant `C₀ = 1`, no sandwich

    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ (D : DirectLdParams) (ε : ℝ), D.k = 1 → 0 < ε →
        ∀ S : Strategy (directLdGame D), S.IsProjective → 1 - ε ≤ S.value →
          ∃ GA : DirectPolyMeasTuple D S.ιA,
            ∃ GB : DirectPolyMeasTuple D S.ιB,
              consistencyDefect
                  (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
                  (fun u outcome =>
                    heteroKron
                      (((S.A (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
                        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome) 1)
                  (fun u outcome =>
                    heteroKron 1
                      ((GB.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome))
                  S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k ∧
              consistencyDefect
                  (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
                  (fun u outcome =>
                    heteroKron
                      ((GA.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome) 1)
                  (fun u outcome =>
                    heteroKron 1
                      (((S.B (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
                        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome))
                  S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k ∧
              consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
                  (fun _ g => heteroKron (GA.effect g) 1)
                  (fun _ g => heteroKron 1 (GB.effect g))

    exists_directSimultaneousPolynomialMeasurements_of_k_eq_one D hk S hS ε hwin
  have hmd : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((D.m : ℝ) * (D.d : ℝ)) / (D.q : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hmature : ∀ hT :
      Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) +
          ((D.m : ℝ) * (D.d : ℝ)) / (D.q : ℝ) + ε ≤ 1,

  · refine consistencyDefect_le_deltaLd_of_transportBound ha hb le_rfl habs D ε hε
      (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
      (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
      (fun u => GA.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u))
      (fun u => (S.B (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)) S.ψ S.ψ_norm ?_
    intro _ hT
    rw [one_mul]
    exact le_trans h2 (hmature hT)
  · refine consistencyDefect_le_deltaLd_of_transportBound ha hb le_rfl habs D ε hε
      (uniformDistribution Unit) (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
      (fun _ => GA) (fun _ => GB) S.ψ S.ψ_norm ?_
    intro _ hT
    rw [one_mul]
    exact le_trans h3 (hmature hT)

/-- The Pauli-test error scale.  The argument order is `(a, b, ε, m, d, q)`;
the powers are real `rpow`s and the asymptotic constants are absorbed into `a`,
as specified by blueprint `thm:pauli`,
paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`).
-/
noncomputable def deltaQld (a b ε : ℝ) (m d q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  a * Real.rpow ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) a *
    (Real.rpow ε b + Real.rpow (q : ℝ) (-b) +
      Real.rpow 2 (-(b * ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ))))

/-- Monotonicity obligation for adjusting the universal constants in
`deltaQld` on the source parameter domain. This Lean-only helper supports the
enlargement of `a` and shrinkage of `b` for `0 ≤ ε ≤ 1` recorded in
`rem:pauli-robustness-form` and stated as `lem:delta-qld-mono-support`,
blueprint `ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex`; the source makes this constant adjustment
at `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1402`. It is
not an additional hypothesis of `thm:pauli` or `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
theorem deltaQld_mono {P : AdmissibleParams} {a a' b b' ε : ℝ}
    (ha0 : 1 ≤ a) (ha : a ≤ a') (hb : b' ≤ b) (hb' : 0 < b')
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :

  have hmd : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    Nat.one_le_cast.mpr (Nat.mul_pos P.one_le_m P.hd)
  have hmd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hq : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (P.q : ℝ) := by
    obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := P.hq

# Square roots of the Pauli soundness error

The state-extraction estimate bounds a squared norm. Taking its square root
preserves the Pauli soundness error family after halving the exponent.

/-- Taking the square root of the Pauli error is bounded by halving its
exponent. This formalization-only scalar estimate supports the passage from
the squared extraction bound to the norm bound in blueprint
`rem:pauli-robustness-form`; it is stated as `thm:pauli-error-square-root-support`.
It holds for all nonnegative errors. -/
theorem sqrt_deltaQld_le {P : AdmissibleParams} {a b epsilon : ℝ}
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon) :
    Real.sqrt (deltaQld a b epsilon P.m P.d P.q) ≤
      deltaQld a (b / 2) epsilon P.m P.d P.q := by
  let degree : ℝ := ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ)
  have hdegree : 1 ≤ degree :=
    Nat.one_le_cast.mpr (Nat.mul_pos P.one_le_m P.hd)
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := zero_le_one.trans ha
  have hdegree0 : 0 ≤ degree := zero_le_one.trans hdegree
  have hprefactor : 1 ≤ a * degree ^ a :=
    one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le ha (Real.one_le_rpow hdegree ha0)
  have hq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ P.q := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have htwo : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by norm_num
  have hroot_sum {x y z : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
      (x + y + z) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
        x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + z ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    (Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow (add_nonneg hx hy) hz (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).trans
      (add_le_add (Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow hx hy (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) le_rfl)
  have hrate :
      (epsilon ^ b + (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-b) + (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(b * degree))) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
        epsilon ^ (b / 2) + (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-(b / 2)) +
          (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((b / 2) * degree)) := by
    have h := hroot_sum (Real.rpow_nonneg hepsilon b) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq (-b))
      (Real.rpow_nonneg htwo (-(b * degree)))
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hepsilon, ← Real.rpow_mul hq, ← Real.rpow_mul htwo] at h
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, neg_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using h
  unfold deltaQld
  simp only [Real.rpow_eq_pow, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  change (a * degree ^ a *
      (epsilon ^ b + (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-b) + (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(b * degree)))) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ _
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (zero_le_one.trans hprefactor) (by positivity)]
  exact mul_le_mul

    (by positivity) (zero_le_one.trans hprefactor)

     4	/-!
     5	# Projective rounding through outcome postprocessing
     6	
     7	Consistent complete POVMs on two possibly different local spaces have projective
     8	roundings on those same spaces. Their consistency with an opposite-player POVM
     9	survives every question-dependent outcome map, with error
    10	`δ + sqrt (220 * δ^(1/4)) + 2 * sqrt (δ + η)` when the original consistency errors
    11	are at most `δ` and `η`. The estimate is independent of both local dimensions and
    12	the number of outcomes.
    13	
    14	These are formalization-only auxiliary results for the compression and rounding
    15	argument preceding the polynomial-support argument in `lem:qld-4-7`. They do not
    16	construct the global polynomial-pair measurement.
    17	
    18	## References
    19	
    20	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:135-145`, `lem:ortho`
    21	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1278-1288`,
    22	  in the proof of `lem:qld-4-7`
    23	- `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:389-401`,
    24	  `fact:triangle-for-simeq` and `fact:data-processing`
    25	- Issue #278
    26	- `audits/2026-09-06_rounding_transport.md`
    27	-/

    20	/-- On the unit interval, all actual rounding terms are bounded by an eighth
    21	root. The point error is controlled through its square root, as in the saved
    22	direct passing bound. The cap uses the independent unit bound on defects. -/
    23	theorem actual_rounding_error_le_root {delta point ratio t : ℝ}
    24	    (hd : 0 ≤ delta) (hp : 0 ≤ point)
    25	    (hdt : delta ≤ t) (hpt : Real.sqrt point ≤ t) (hrt : ratio ≤ t) :
    26	    min 1 (32 * delta + 32 * Real.sqrt (220 * delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
    27	      64 * Real.sqrt (2 * delta) + 64 * point + 30 * ratio) ≤
    28	      1024 * Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (min 1 t))) := by
    29	  have ht : 0 ≤ t := hd.trans hdt
    30	  by_cases ht1 : t ≤ 1
    31	  · rw [min_eq_right ht1]
    32	    have hroot : Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt t)) = t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    33	      simp only [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    34	      rw [← Real.rpow_mul ht, ← Real.rpow_mul ht]
    35	      norm_num
    36	    rw [hroot]
    37	    have h18 : t ≤ t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    38	      simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' ht ht1
    39	        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8) (by norm_num : (1 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    40	    have h14 : t ≤ t ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    41	      simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' ht ht1
    42	        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4) (by norm_num : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    43	    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (t ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) = t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    44	      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul ht]
    45	      norm_num
    46	    have hround : Real.sqrt (220 * delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) ≤
    47	        15 * t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    48	      calc
    49	        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (225 * t ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    50	          (mul_le_mul (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_le_rpow hd hdt (by norm_num))
    51	            (Real.rpow_nonneg hd _) (by norm_num))
    52	        _ = _ := by rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), hsqrt]; norm_num
    53	    have hsecond : Real.sqrt (2 * delta) ≤ 2 * t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    54	      calc
    55	        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (4 * t ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) :=
    56	          Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith [Real.rpow_nonneg ht (1 / 4 : ℝ)])
    57	        _ = _ := by rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), hsqrt]; norm_num
    58	    have hpoint : point ≤ t := by
    59	      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hp, Real.sqrt_nonneg point]
    60	    refine (min_le_right _ _).trans ?_
    61	    nlinarith [Real.rpow_nonneg ht (1 / 8 : ℝ)]
    62	  · rw [min_eq_left (le_of_not_ge ht1)]
    63	    norm_num

     3	/-! # Polynomial error predicates
     4	
     5	Shared quantitative predicates for the polynomial-error bounds in QPBT
     6	chapters 12, 14, and 15.
     7	
     8	## References
     9	
    10	These are formalization-only auxiliaries for polynomially small QPBT error
    11	functions. The one-parameter form includes the explicit square-root witnesses
    12	in paper chapter 14; the two-parameter form is used by `lem:pasting` in paper
    13	chapter 6.
    14	-/
    15	
    16	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    17	
    18	/-- A nonnegative one-parameter error function bounded by a positive real power.
    19	
    20	**Local fix:** The prefactor and exponent are quantified separately. Paper
    21	chapter 14 explicitly obtains `sqrt ε` at
    22	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:508-520,649-676`, which the coupled
    23	constant in the shorthand at `04_preliminaries.tex:26-29` cannot bound on all
    24	positive inputs. The correction is documented in
    25	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_polynomial-error-square-root.tex` and tracked by issue
    26	#16. -/
    27	def IsPolyErr (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
    28	  ∃ C r : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ 0 < r ∧ ∀ x, 0 ≤ x →
    29	    0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ C * Real.rpow x r
    30	
    31	/-- A nonnegative two-parameter error function bounded by a sum of positive
    32	real powers.
    33	
    34	**Local fix:** The prefactor and the two exponents are quantified separately,
    35	and the bound is imposed on the closed nonnegative quadrant. The shorthand at
    36	`04_preliminaries.tex:22-29` reads `poly` of several arguments as a single
    37	power of their product, which forces the pasting error of `lem:pasting` at
    38	`06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525` to tend to zero with the collision
    39	error at every fixed positive consistency error; a two-dimensional strategy
    40	refutes the resulting statement. A sum of separate positive powers vanishes
    41	exactly when both errors vanish, and bounds the terms the imported proof of
    42	Fact 4.35 produces. The correction is documented in
    43	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_pasting-product-error.tex` and tracked by issue #196. -/
    44	def IsPolyErr₂ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
    45	  ∃ C r s : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ 0 < r ∧ 0 < s ∧ ∀ x y, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ y →
    46	    0 ≤ f x y ∧ f x y ≤ C * (Real.rpow x r + Real.rpow y s)
    47	
    48	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

-private theorem sqrt_deficit_bound_le (m δP δQ : ℝ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hP : 0 ≤ δP)
+/-- The square root of the two consistency deficits is bounded by their
+quarter powers, retaining the dimension factor in paper `claim:17-2`.
+Exported as in PR549; the existing proof is unchanged. -/
+theorem sqrt_deficit_bound_le (m δP δQ : ℝ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hP : 0 ≤ δP)
     (hQ : 0 ≤ δQ) :
     Real.sqrt (2 * Real.sqrt (4 * m ^ 2 * δP) + 2 * Real.sqrt (4 * δQ)) ≤
       2 * Real.sqrt m * (Real.rpow δP (1 / 4 : ℝ) + Real.rpow δQ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
   have hm0 : 0 ≤ m := by linarith
   have hsqrtm : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt m := by
     rw [← Real.sqrt_one]
     exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hm
   have h1 : Real.sqrt (4 * m ^ 2 * δP) = 2 * m * Real.sqrt δP := by
     rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), show (4 * m ^ 2 : ℝ) = (2 * m) ^ 2 by ring,
       Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)]
   have h2 : Real.sqrt (4 * δQ) = 2 * Real.sqrt δQ := by
     rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num,
       Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
   have hquarter : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x →
       Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt x) = Real.rpow x (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
     intro x hx
     rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hx]
     norm_num
   have hsplit : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b →
       Real.sqrt (a + b) ≤ Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b := by
     intro a b ha hb
     rw [← Real.sqrt_sq (add_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg a) (Real.sqrt_nonneg b))]
     refine Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ?_
     nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt ha, Real.sq_sqrt hb, Real.sqrt_nonneg a,
       Real.sqrt_nonneg b]
   have hPa : 0 ≤ 2 * (2 * m * Real.sqrt δP) :=
     mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
       (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hm0) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
   have hQa : 0 ≤ 2 * (2 * Real.sqrt δQ) :=
     mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
   have hPb : Real.sqrt (2 * (2 * m * Real.sqrt δP)) =
       2 * Real.sqrt m * Real.rpow δP (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
     rw [show 2 * (2 * m * Real.sqrt δP) = 2 ^ 2 * m * Real.sqrt δP by ring,
       Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ 2),
       Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), hquarter δP hP]
   have hQb : Real.sqrt (2 * (2 * Real.sqrt δQ)) = 2 * Real.rpow δQ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
     rw [show 2 * (2 * Real.sqrt δQ) = 2 ^ 2 * Real.sqrt δQ by ring,
       Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ 2),
       Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), hquarter δQ hQ]

           Real.sqrt (2 * (2 * Real.sqrt δQ)) := hsplit _ _ hPa hQa
     _ = 2 * Real.sqrt m * Real.rpow δP (1 / 4 : ℝ) +
           2 * Real.rpow δQ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by rw [hPb, hQb]

           (Real.rpow δP (1 / 4 : ℝ) + Real.rpow δQ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
       have hQ4 : 0 ≤ Real.rpow δQ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hQ _

    32	private theorem coeff_coeff_sumRingEquiv {F A B : Type*} [CommSemiring F]
    33	    (p : MvPolynomial (A ⊕ B) F) (a : A →₀ ℕ) (b : B →₀ ℕ) :
    34	    ((MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F A B p).coeff a).coeff b =
    35	      p.coeff (Finsupp.sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp.symm (a, b)) := by

    39	private theorem totalDegree_le_of_exponents {F : Type*} [CommSemiring F]
    40	    {n d : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F)
    41	    (h : ∀ e ∈ p.support, ∀ i, e i ≤ d) : p.totalDegree ≤ n * d := by
    42	  rw [MvPolynomial.totalDegree, Finset.sup_le_iff]
    43	  intro e he
    44	  rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (by simp)]
    45	  calc
    46	    ∑ i : Fin n, e i ≤ ∑ _i : Fin n, d := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => h e he i
    47	    _ = n * d := by simp

    49	private theorem sumRingEquiv_degrees {F : Type*} [CommSemiring F] {k n d : ℕ}
    50	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin n) F)
    51	    (h : ∀ e ∈ p.support, ∀ i, e i ≤ d) :
    52	    (∀ a, ((MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F (Fin k) (Fin n) p).coeff a).totalDegree ≤
    53	      n * d) ∧ (MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F (Fin k) (Fin n) p).totalDegree ≤ k * d := by
    54	  have hc (a : Fin k →₀ ℕ) (b : Fin n →₀ ℕ)
    55	      (hb : b ∈ ((MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F (Fin k) (Fin n) p).coeff a).support) :
    56	      Finsupp.sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp.symm (a, b) ∈ p.support := by
    57	    simpa only [MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff, coeff_coeff_sumRingEquiv] using hb
    58	  constructor
    59	  · intro a
    60	    apply totalDegree_le_of_exponents
    61	    intro b hb i
    62	    simpa using h _ (hc a b hb) (Sum.inr i)
    63	  · apply totalDegree_le_of_exponents
    64	    intro a ha i
    65	    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := MvPolynomial.support_nonempty.mpr
    66	      (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp ha)
    67	    simpa using h _ (hc a b hb) (Sum.inl i)

    87	private theorem scalarPolynomial_renamed_exponents (P : AdmissibleParams)
    88	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) :
    89	    ∀ e ∈ (MvPolynomial.rename (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m)
    90	      (MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1)).support,
    91	      ∀ i, e i ≤ P.d := by
    92	  intro e he i
    93	  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvp⟩ := MvPolynomial.coeff_rename_ne_zero _ _ _
    94	    (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp he)
    95	  have hmem := MvPolynomial.support_map_subset _ _ (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hvp)
    96	  have hdeg := Preliminaries.degreeOf_le_of_mem_polyFunc (g (0 : Fin 1)).2
    97	    ((scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm i)
    98	  have hvbound := (MvPolynomial.le_degreeOf_of_mem_support _ hmem).trans hdeg
    99	  change v ((scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm i) ≤ P.d at hvbound
   100	  subst e

   103	/-- Both degree bounds follow from the genuine individual-degree certificate:
   104	every base coefficient has degree at most `2md`, and the outer scalar
   105	polynomial has degree at most `2d`. No degree hypothesis is added. -/
   106	theorem scalarPolynomial_degrees (P : AdmissibleParams)
   107	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) :
   108	    (∀ a, ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a).totalDegree ≤ 2 * P.m * P.d) ∧
   109	      (scalarPolynomial P g).totalDegree ≤ 2 * P.d := by
   110	  exact sumRingEquiv_degrees _ (scalarPolynomial_renamed_exponents P g)

   112	/-- Split a base coefficient into a polynomial in either varying block with
   113	coefficients in the fixed block. The value `false` selects `x` as varying and
   114	`true` selects `z`. This supports the two applications of `eq:qld-g-2` in
   115	paper lines 1341--1358 and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   116	def blockCoefficientPolynomial (P : AdmissibleParams)
   117	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool) :
   118	    MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (PauliScalar P)) :=
   119	  MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv _ _ _ (MvPolynomial.rename
   120	    ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   121	      (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)) ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a))

   123	private theorem blockCoefficientPolynomial_renamed_exponents (P : AdmissibleParams)
   124	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool) :
   125	    ∀ e ∈ (MvPolynomial.rename ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   126	      (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _))
   127	        ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a)).support, ∀ i, e i ≤ P.d := by
   128	  intro e he i
   129	  let eqv := (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   130	    (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)
   131	  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvp⟩ := MvPolynomial.coeff_rename_ne_zero _ _ _
   132	    (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp he)
   133	  have hcoeff :
   134	      (MvPolynomial.rename (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m)
   135	        (MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1)).coeff
   136	        (Finsupp.sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp.symm (a, v)) ≠ 0 := by
   137	    simpa only [scalarPolynomial, coeff_coeff_sumRingEquiv] using hvp
   138	  have hb := scalarPolynomial_renamed_exponents P g _
   139	    (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hcoeff) (.inr (eqv.symm i))
   140	  change v (eqv.symm i) ≤ P.d at hb
   141	  subst e
   142	  simpa only [Finsupp.mapDomain_equiv_apply] using hb

   144	/-- Both partial degrees are at most `md`, for either choice of varying
   145	block, directly from the actual outcome's individual-degree certificate.
   146	This supplies the coefficient and fiber bounds in `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting
   147	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`; no degree or specialization premise is added. -/
   148	theorem blockCoefficientPolynomial_degrees (P : AdmissibleParams)
   149	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool) :
   150	    (∀ e, ((blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse).coeff e).totalDegree ≤ P.m * P.d) ∧
   151	      (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse).totalDegree ≤ P.m * P.d := by
   152	  exact sumRingEquiv_degrees _ (blockCoefficientPolynomial_renamed_exponents P g a reverse)

   154	/-- The field and coordinate transports preserve the complete singleton
   155	polynomial outcome, including its formal coefficients, not only its values. -/
   156	theorem scalarPolynomial_injective (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   157	    Function.Injective (scalarPolynomial P) := by
   158	  intro g h heq
   159	  have hs := (MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv (PauliScalar P) (Fin 2)
   160	    (Fin (2 * P.m))).injective heq
   161	  have hr := MvPolynomial.rename_injective (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m)
   162	    (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m).injective hs
   163	  have hc := MvPolynomial.map_injective (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom
   164	    (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).injective hr
   165	  funext j
   166	  have hj : j = (0 : Fin 1) := @Subsingleton.elim (Fin 1) _ j 0
   167	  subst j
   168	  exact Subtype.ext hc

   170	/-- The combined degree term in the recovered concentration estimate. -/
   171	theorem scalarPolynomial_degree_term_le (P : AdmissibleParams)
   172	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) :
   173	    ((scalarPolynomial P g).support.sup fun e =>
   174	      ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff e).totalDegree) +
   175	        max 1 (scalarPolynomial P g).totalDegree + 1 ≤ (2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 := by
   176	  have h := scalarPolynomial_degrees P g
   177	  have hc : ((scalarPolynomial P g).support.sup fun e =>
   178	      ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff e).totalDegree) ≤ 2 * P.m * P.d :=
   179	    Finset.sup_le fun e _ => h.1 e
   180	  have ho : max 1 (scalarPolynomial P g).totalDegree ≤ 2 * P.d :=
   181	    max_le (by have := P.hd; omega) h.2
   182	  calc
   183	    _ ≤ 2 * P.m * P.d + 2 * P.d + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.add_le_add hc ho) 1
   184	    _ = _ := by ring

   186	private theorem eval_sumRingEquiv {F A B : Type*} [CommSemiring F]
   187	    (p : MvPolynomial (A ⊕ B) F) (u : B → F) (v : A → F) :
   188	    MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u)
   189	      (MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F A B p)) = MvPolynomial.eval (Sum.elim v u) p := by
   190	  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
   191	  | C a => simp
   192	  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
   193	  | mul_X p i hp => cases i <;> simp [hp]

   197	def scalarBaseQuestionEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   198	    ((Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P) × (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) ≃
   199	      ExtendedPointQuestion P :=
   200	  (((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).piCongrLeft fun _ => PauliScalar P).trans
   201	    (Equiv.sumPiEquivProdPi fun _ : Fin P.m ⊕ Fin P.m => PauliScalar P)).prodCongr
   202	      (finTwoArrowEquiv (PauliScalar P))

   205	    (u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) :

   208	        (Sum.elim v u (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m i)) := by
   209	  apply (directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv P).injective
   210	  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv_apply]
   211	  apply Prod.ext
   212	  · apply Prod.ext <;> funext i <;>
   213	      simp [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv, scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv, projX, projZ,
   214	        embX, embZ, directPointToPauli, Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply]
   215	  · apply Prod.ext <;>

   219	/-- Evaluation of the nested polynomial is exactly the actual singleton readout,
   220	including the canonical field transport and all four coordinate blocks. -/
   221	theorem scalarPolynomial_eval (P : AdmissibleParams)
   222	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd)
   223	    (u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) :
   224	    MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) (scalarPolynomial P g)) =
   225	      extendedPolynomialRead P (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)) g := by
   226	  rw [scalarPolynomial, eval_sumRingEquiv, MvPolynomial.eval_rename,
   227	    MvPolynomial.eval_map]
   228	  unfold extendedPolynomialRead evalDirectPolyTupleAt
   229	  rw [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv_direct]
   230	  have h := (MvPolynomial.eval₂_comp (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom
   231	      (fun i => (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm
   232	        (Sum.elim v u (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m i))) (g (0 : Fin 1)).1).symm
   233	  change MvPolynomial.eval₂ (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom
   234	      (fun i => extendedDirectScalarEquiv P ((extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm
   235	        (Sum.elim v u (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m i)))) (g (0 : Fin 1)).1 = _ at h
   236	  simp only [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
   237	  exact h
