   239	/-- Exact partial evaluation for either block order. This is the coefficient
   240	specialization used in `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   241	theorem blockCoefficientPolynomial_eval (P : AdmissibleParams)
   242	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool)
   243	    (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   244	    MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   245	      (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse)) =
   246	    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => Sum.elim x z
   247	      (((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   248	        (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)) i))
   249	      ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a) := by
   250	  rw [blockCoefficientPolynomial, eval_sumRingEquiv, MvPolynomial.eval_rename]
   251	  rfl

   253	/-- Joint sample equivalence for the fiber calculation: the first input block
   254	is fixed and the second varies. Reversal exchanges both the point blocks and
   255	the scalar coefficients, so its ordered product is `ZX`. This supports the
   256	two orders in `eq:qld-g-42/43` and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   257	def fiberQuestionEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) (reverse : Bool) :
   258	    (((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) ×
   259	      (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) ≃ ExtendedPointQuestion P :=
   260	  (if reverse then Equiv.refl _ else Equiv.prodComm _ _).prodCongr
   261	    ((finTwoArrowEquiv (PauliScalar P)).trans
   262	      (if reverse then Equiv.prodComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _))
   263	
   264	/-- For a scalar-linear outcome, its actual readout equals the two specialized
   265	coefficient polynomials in the corresponding block and scalar order. This is
   266	an exact identity, with no field-size condition; support for `eq:qld-g-48`
   267	and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   268	theorem scalarPolynomial_linear_read_fiber (P : AdmissibleParams)
   269	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd)
   270	    (hg : ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P),
   271	      scalarPolynomial P g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
   272	        MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   273	    (reverse : Bool) (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) :
   274	    extendedPolynomialRead P (fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v)) g =
   275	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   276	        (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 1 else 0) 1)
   277	          reverse)) +
   278	      v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   279	        (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 0 else 1) 1)
   280	          reverse)) := by
   281	  obtain ⟨r, t, hg⟩ := hg
   282	  let u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P := fun i => Sum.elim x z
   283	    (((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   284	      (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)) i)
   285	  let v' : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P := if reverse then ![v 1, v 0] else v
   286	  have heq : scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v') =
   287	      fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v) := by
   288	    cases reverse <;> simp [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv, fiberQuestionEquiv, u, v',
   289	      Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply]
   290	  rw [← heq, ← scalarPolynomial_eval, hg]
   291	  simp_rw [blockCoefficientPolynomial_eval, hg]
   292	  have h01 : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 := by
   293	    intro h
   294	    simpa using congrArg (fun e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => e 0) h
   295	  simp only [map_add, map_mul, MvPolynomial.map_C, MvPolynomial.map_X,
   296	    MvPolynomial.eval_C, MvPolynomial.eval_X]
   297	  cases reverse <;>
   298	    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, MvPolynomial.coeff_add,
   299	      MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, h01, Ne.symm h01,
   300	      ↓reduceIte, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
   301	  · change MvPolynomial.eval u r * v 0 + MvPolynomial.eval u t * v 1 =
   302	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval u r + v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval u t
   303	    ring
   304	  · change MvPolynomial.eval u r * v 1 + MvPolynomial.eval u t * v 0 =
   305	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval u t + v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval u r
   306	    ring

   317	private theorem blockCoefficientPolynomial_const {P : AdmissibleParams}
   318	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool)
   319	    (h : ∃ r, blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse = MvPolynomial.C r) :
   320	    ∃ r : Poly P, (scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a = MvPolynomial.rename
   321	      (fun i => ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   322	        (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)).symm (.inr i)) r.1 := by
   323	  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h
   324	  have hmem : r ∈ Preliminaries.polyFunc P.m (PauliScalar P) P.d := by
   325	    apply mem_polyFunc_of_degreeOf_le
   326	    intro i
   327	    apply MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_iff.mpr
   328	    intro b hb
   329	    have hcoeff :
   330	        ((blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse).coeff 0).coeff b ≠ 0 := by
   331	      simpa only [hr, MvPolynomial.coeff_C, ↓reduceIte] using MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hb
   332	    have hsupport : Finsupp.sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp.symm (0, b) ∈
   333	        (MvPolynomial.rename ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans

   339	  refine ⟨⟨r, hmem⟩, ?_⟩
   340	  let eqv := (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans

   342	  apply MvPolynomial.rename_injective eqv eqv.injective

   344	  change blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse = _
   345	  rw [hr, MvPolynomial.rename_rename]
   346	  have heq : eqv ∘ (fun i => eqv.symm (.inr i)) = Sum.inr := by
   347	    funext i
   348	    exact eqv.apply_symm_apply _
   349	  change MvPolynomial.C r =
   350	    MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv _ _ _ (MvPolynomial.rename
   351	      (eqv ∘ (fun i => eqv.symm (.inr i))) r)
   352	  rw [heq, sumRingEquiv_rename_inr]

   354	private theorem scalarExpansion_combinePoly (P : AdmissibleParams)
   355	    (f h : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (PauliScalar P)) :
   356	    MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv _ _ _
   357	      (MvPolynomial.rename (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m) (combinePoly f h)) =
   358	    MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.rename
   359	      (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inl i)) f) * MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 2) +
   360	    MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.rename
   361	      (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inr i)) h) * MvPolynomial.X 1 := by
   362	  have hX : scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m ∘ embX P.m =
   363	      Sum.inr ∘ (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inl i)) := by

     9	vector is not assumed normalized: its squared norm controls the exceptional
    10	coefficient, so the estimate can be summed over all polynomial outcomes.

    12	player's placed expanded measurements.

    15	image, with its actual ordered-correlation error displayed in the conclusion.

    45	/-- The ordered product selected by the linear field-answer check in
    46	`eq:qld-g-42`. This is an operator, not an asserted measurement effect. -/
    47	def orderedIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    48	  ∑ bc : F × F, if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    49	
    50	/-- The diagonal sandwich sum in `eq:qld-g-prime`. -/
    51	def diagonalIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    52	  ∑ bc : F × F,
    53	    if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then
    54	      Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    55	
    56	/-- For a nonzero second coefficient, X orthogonality and cancellation in
    57	the field eliminate every off-diagonal term of the ordered Gram operator.
    58	This is the exact local algebra behind `eq:qld-g-prime`; no commutation of
    59	the X and Z measurements is assumed. -/
    60	private theorem orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    61	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0) :
    62	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a =
    63	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a := by
    64	  classical
    65	  unfold orderedIndicator diagonalIndicator
    66	  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    67	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun bc _ => ?_
    68	  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single bc]
    69	  · by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    70	    · simp only [if_pos h, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, measurement_effect_hermitian]
    71	      rw [mul_assoc (Z.effect bc.2), ← mul_assoc (X.effect bc.1),
    72	        (hX bc.1).isIdempotentElem.eq, ← mul_assoc]
    73	    · simp [h]
    74	  · intro bc' _ hne
    75	    by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    76	    · by_cases h' : α * bc'.1 + β * bc'.2 = a
    77	      · have hb : bc.1 ≠ bc'.1 := by
    78	          intro hb
    79	          have hc : bc.2 = bc'.2 := mul_left_cancel₀ hβ (by
    80	            apply add_left_cancel (a := α * bc.1)
    81	            simpa only [hb] using h.trans h'.symm)
    82	          exact hne (Prod.ext hb hc).symm
    83	        simp only [if_pos h, if_pos h', Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    84	          measurement_effect_hermitian]
    85	        calc
    86	          Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * (X.effect bc'.1 * Z.effect bc'.2) =
    87	              Z.effect bc.2 * (X.effect bc.1 * X.effect bc'.1) * Z.effect bc'.2 := by
    88	            simp only [mul_assoc]
    89	          _ = 0 := by rw [projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero X hX hb]; simp
    90	      · simp [h']
    91	    · simp [h]
    92	  · simp

    94	/-- The squared state norm of the ordered indicator equals its diagonal
    95	sandwich quadratic form when the second coefficient is nonzero. -/
    96	private theorem orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    97	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    98	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    99	    ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 =
   100	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) := by
   101	  rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq,
   102	    orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   103	  rfl

   105	/-- The diagonal indicator is a positive contraction, since it selects
   106	effects from the complete sandwich POVM. -/
   107	private theorem diagonalIndicator_bounds (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   108	    (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   109	    0 ≤ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ∧ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   110	  obtain ⟨hpos, hsum⟩ := pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ
   111	  change (∀ bc : F × F, 0 ≤ Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) at hpos
   112	  change (∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) = 1 at hsum
   113	  constructor
   114	  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun bc _ => by
   115	      split_ifs
   116	      · exact hpos bc
   117	      · exact le_refl 0
   118	  · calc
   119	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤
   120	          ∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 := by
   121	        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun bc _ => ?_
   122	        split_ifs
   123	        · exact le_refl _
   124	        · exact hpos bc
   125	      _ = 1 := hsum

   128	coarse-grained X projection. This includes zero first coefficient. -/
   129	private theorem orderedIndicator_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α a : F) :
   130	    orderedIndicator X Z α 0 a = (X.postprocess (fun b => α * b)).effect a := by
   131	  unfold orderedIndicator
   132	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
   133	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   134	  by_cases h : α * b = a
   135	  · simp only [zero_mul, add_zero, h, if_true]
   136	    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Z.sum_eq_one, mul_one]
   137	  · simp [h]

   140	second coefficient this follows from the diagonal identity; at zero it
   141	follows from completeness and projective postprocessing. -/
   142	theorem orderedIndicator_gram_le_one (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   143	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   144	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   145	  by_cases hβ : β = 0

   149	    exact measurement_effect_le_one _ _

   173	  · rw [if_neg hβ, orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ ψ]

   345	/-- Adding the genuinely uniform zero-coefficient contribution gives the
   346	ordered-projector estimate for a polynomial outside the scalar-linear image.
   347	The right side retains the squared norm of the unnormalized state. -/
   348	private theorem avg_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_not_linear {n : ℕ}
   349	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F))
   350	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r s : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F,
   351	      p = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C s * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   352	    (X Z : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   353	    (hX : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (X u))
   354	    (hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u)) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :

   356	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   357	        ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   358	          (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p))) ψ‖ ^ 2)) ≤

   361	  let f (u : Fin n → F) (v : Fin 2 → F) : F :=
   362	    MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p)
   363	  have hexc : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   364	      (fun v => if v 1 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) =
   365	        (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   366	    change avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   367	      (fun v => if ((finTwoArrowEquiv F) v).2 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) = _
   368	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   369	    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   370	    rw [avgOver_uniform_snd (fun β : F => if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0)]
   371	    simp [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]
   372	  calc
   373	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   374	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   375	          stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1) (f u v)) +
   376	            (if v 1 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0))) := by
   377	      apply avgOver_mono
   378	      intro u
   379	      apply avgOver_mono
   380	      intro v

   386	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   387	          stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1) (f u v)))) +
   388	            (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   389	      simp_rw [avgOver_add, hexc, avgOver_uniform_const]
   390	    _ ≤ ((p.support.sup fun e => (p.coeff e).totalDegree) + max 1 p.totalDegree : ℕ) /
   391	        (Fintype.card F : ℝ) * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 + (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 :=
   392	      add_le_add (avg_diagonalIndicator_le_of_not_linear p hp X Z hZ ψ) le_rfl
   393	    _ = _ := by push_cast; ring

   395	/-- The ordered polynomial estimate sums over any specified set of polynomial
   396	labels outside the scalar-linear image. Each label is weighted by its actual
   397	state mass; the estimate never replaces a sum by the number of labels. -/
   398	private theorem avg_sum_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_not_linear {n : ℕ} {Γ : Type*}
   399	    (s : Finset Γ) (p : Γ → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F))
   400	    (hp : ∀ g ∈ s, ¬ ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F,
   401	      p g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   402	    (X Z : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   403	    (hX : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (X u))
   404	    (hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u)) (ψ : Γ → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   405	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   406	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s,
   407	        ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   408	          (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) (p g)))) (ψ g)‖ ^ 2)) ≤
   409	      ∑ g ∈ s,
   410	        (((p g).support.sup fun e => ((p g).coeff e).totalDegree) +
   411	          max 1 (p g).totalDegree + 1 : ℕ) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ) * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 := by
   412	  simp_rw [avgOver_finset_sum]
   413	  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun g hg =>
   414	    avg_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_not_linear (p g) (hp g hg) X Z hX hZ (ψ g)
   415

   417	/-- The squared-norm triangle inequality retains each outcome's state vector.
   418	This is the norm-to-residual step recovered from PR296, now shared with the
   419	wrong-variable argument in `eq:qld-g-prime-xpt-bound`; support for blueprint
   420	`lem:qld-4-7`. No normalization is assumed. -/
   421	theorem sum_mass_le_residual_add_image {Γ : Type*} (s : Finset Γ)
   422	    (ψ A : Γ → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   423	    ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤
   424	      2 * ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g - A g‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ∑ g ∈ s, ‖A g‖ ^ 2 := by
   425	  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   426	  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun g _ => ?_
   427	  have htriangle := norm_add_le (ψ g - A g) (A g)
   428	  rw [sub_add_cancel] at htriangle
   429	  have hsquare := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) htriangle 2
   430	  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖ψ g - A g‖ - ‖A g‖)]
   431	
   432	/-- Scalar-linearity concentration with the actual ordered-correlation error
   433	displayed in the conclusion. Combining this inequality with `eq:qld-g-42`
   434	requires deriving that correlation from the source measurements; no such
   435	estimate is an input to this auxiliary theorem. -/
   436	theorem nonlinear_mass_le_ordered_error {n : ℕ} {Γ : Type*}
   437	    (s : Finset Γ) (p : Γ → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F))
   438	    (hp : ∀ g ∈ s, ¬ ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F,
   439	      p g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   440	    (X Z : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   441	    (hX : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (X u))
   442	    (hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u)) (ψ : Γ → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   443	    ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤
   444	      2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   445	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s,
   446	          ‖ψ g - applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   447	            (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) (p g)))) (ψ g)‖ ^ 2)) +
   448	      2 * ∑ g ∈ s,
   449	        (((p g).support.sup fun e => ((p g).coeff e).totalDegree) +
   450	          max 1 (p g).totalDegree + 1 : ℕ) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ) * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 := by

   452	    applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   453	      (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) (p g)))) (ψ g)
   454	  have hpoint (u : Fin n → F) (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   455	      ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤
   456	        2 * ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g - A u v g‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ∑ g ∈ s, ‖A u v g‖ ^ 2 :=
   457	    sum_mass_le_residual_add_image s ψ (A u v)
   458	  have havg := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) _ _ fun u =>
   459	    avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) _ _ (hpoint u)
   460	  simp only [avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_add, avgOver_const_mul] at havg
   461	  have hnorm := avg_sum_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_not_linear s p hp X Z hX hZ ψ
   462	  change ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))

   464	      (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g - A u v g‖ ^ 2)) + _
   465	  change avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   466	    (fun u => avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   467	      (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s, ‖A u v g‖ ^ 2)) ≤ _ at hnorm

     4	/-!
     5	# Common exceptional fibers for polynomial coefficients
     6	
     7	A nonconstant polynomial in one block, with polynomial coefficients in a
     8	second block, has one nonzero nonconstant coefficient. Its zero set controls
     9	all exceptional specializations simultaneously, independently of the outcome
    10	of a measurement. The weights may depend on the fixed block but not on the
    11	block being averaged.
    12	
    13	## References
    14	
    15	Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1341-1358`,
    16	especially `eq:qld-g-2`; support for blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    20	
    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolynomialImageBounds
    22	
    23	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    24	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus

    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	variable {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]
    29	
    30	private theorem exists_nonconstant_coeff {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ}
    31	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r) :
    32	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
    33	  classical
    34	  by_contra! h
    35	  apply hp
    36	  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
    37	  ext e
    38	  by_cases he : e = 0
    39	  · simp [he]
    40	  · simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he, h e he]
    41	
    42	/-- A single coefficient defines the exceptional slices for every field
    43	outcome. Outside its zero set, every fiber has probability at most `D/q`;
    44	the exceptional set itself has probability at most `C/q`. Both degree
    45	conditions concern the displayed polynomial, not an assumed collision law.
    46	This is the common-set argument following `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting
    47	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    48	theorem exists_common_exceptional_coefficient {n k C D : ℕ}
    49	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
    50	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    51	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D) :
    52	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 ∧
    53	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F))
    54	        (fun z => if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
    55	          (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F ∧
    56	      ∀ z : Fin k → F, MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) ≠ 0 → ∀ b : F,
    57	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    58	          (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    59	            then 1 else 0) ≤ (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F := by
    60	  obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := exists_nonconstant_coeff p hp
    61	  refine ⟨e, he, hc, ?_, ?_⟩
    62	  · simpa using avg_eval_eq_le (p.coeff e) 0 hc (hcoeff e) (by simp)
    63	  · intro z hz b
    64	    have hne : MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p ≠ MvPolynomial.C b := by
    65	      intro h
    66	      apply hz
    67	      have h' := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff e) h
    68	      simpa [MvPolynomial.coeff_map, MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he] using h'
    69	    have hd : (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p).totalDegree ≤ D :=
    70	      (Finset.sup_mono (MvPolynomial.support_map_subset _ _)).trans hdegree
    71	    simpa using avg_eval_eq_le _ (MvPolynomial.C b) hne hd (by simp)
    72	
    73	/-- Summing all nonnegative outcome weights before averaging exceptional
    74	slices avoids an outcome-cardinality factor. The weights may depend on `z`
    75	and their sum is the same mass `M` at every `z`. This is the weighted fiber
    76	calculation in `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    77	theorem avg_weighted_fiber_le {n k C D : ℕ}
    78	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
    79	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    80	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D)
    81	    (w : (Fin k → F) → F → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    82	    (hw : ∀ z b, 0 ≤ w z b) (hsum : ∀ z, ∑ b, w z b = M) :
    83	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z => ∑ b : F,
    84	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    85	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    86	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤ ((C + D : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
    87	  classical
    88	  obtain ⟨e, _, _, hbad, hgood⟩ :=
    89	    exists_common_exceptional_coefficient p hp hcoeff hdegree
    90	  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by
    91	    rw [← hsum (fun _ => 0)]
    92	    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => hw _ b
    93	  have hpoint (z : Fin k → F) :
    94	      (∑ b : F, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    95	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    96	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤
    97	      (if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * M +
    98	        (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
    99	    by_cases hz : MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0
   100	    · simp only [hz, if_true, one_mul]
   101	      apply le_trans (b := M)
   102	      · rw [← hsum z]
   103	        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   104	        intro b _
   105	        apply le_trans (b := 1 * w z b)
   106	        · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hw z b)
   107	          apply avgOver_uniform_le_const
   108	          intro x
   109	          split_ifs <;> norm_num
   110	        · rw [one_mul]
   111	      · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hM)
   112	    · simp only [hz, if_false, zero_mul, zero_add]
   113	      rw [← hsum z, Finset.mul_sum]
   114	      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ =>
   115	        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hgood z hz b) (hw z b)
   116	  calc
   117	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   118	        (if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * M +
   119	          (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M) := avgOver_mono _ _ _ hpoint
   120	    _ ≤ (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M + (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
   121	      rw [avgOver_add, avgOver_mul_const, avgOver_uniform_const]
   122	      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbad hM) le_rfl
   123	    _ = _ := by push_cast; ring

   125	variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

   127	private theorem avg_diagonalIndicator_linear_le
   128	    (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   129	    (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   130	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   131	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t))) ≤
   132	      (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   133	        stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t * X.effect r * Z.effect t) := by
   134	  classical
   135	  let w (bc : F × F) : ℝ := stateQForm ψ
   136	    (Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2)
   137	  have hw (bc : F × F) : 0 ≤ w bc :=
   138	    stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).1 bc)
   139	  have hsum : ∑ bc, w bc = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   140	    rw [← stateQForm_one ψ, ← (pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).2,
   141	      stateQForm_finset_sum]
   142	    rfl
   143	  have hexpand (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   144	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) =
   145	      ∑ bc : F × F, (if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t
   146	        then 1 else 0) * w bc := by
   147	    rw [diagonalIndicator, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   148	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   149	    intro bc _
   150	    split_ifs <;> simp [w, stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
   151	  have hcollision (bc : F × F) :
   152	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   153	        if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
   154	        if bc = (r, t) then 1 else (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
   155	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   156	    exact affine_collision_average bc (r, t)
   157	  simp_rw [hexpand, avgOver_sum, avgOver_mul_const, hcollision]

    16	/-- Under the unchanged diagonal line-point law, zero projected directions have

    18	vanish and is uniform. Source: `def:line-point-dist`, paper
    19	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`. This proof-only bound
    20	supports the collision restriction in issue #118. -/
    21	theorem dLinePointDist_zero_direction_mass_le (L : LdParams) :
    22	    avgOver (dLinePointDist L) (fun sample =>
    23	      if sample.1.direction = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
    24	      1 / Fintype.card (ScalarQ L) := by
    25	  classical
    26	  let last : Fin L.m := ⟨L.m - 1, by have := L.hm; omega⟩
    27	  let coord : LdIndex L := .inr last
    28	  have hmap : (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map (fun raw => raw coord) =
    29	      uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L) := by
    30	    change (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map
    31	      (fun raw => (Equiv.funSplitAt coord (ScalarQ L) raw).1) = _
    32	    rw [← Distribution.map_map, uniformDistribution_map_equiv,
    33	      uniformDistribution_map_fst]
    34	  have hzero : avgOver (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L))
    35	      (fun raw => if raw coord = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
    36	      1 / Fintype.card (ScalarQ L) := by
    37	    rw [← Distribution.avgOver_map (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L))
    38	      (fun raw => raw coord) (fun value => if value = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0), hmap]
    39	    simp [avgOver, uniformDistribution_weight_apply, mul_ite]
    40	  unfold dLinePointDist clDistribution
    41	  rw [Distribution.avgOver_map, Distribution.avgOver_map]
    42	  refine le_trans (avgOver_mono _ _ _ ?_) hzero.le
    43	  intro raw
    44	  dsimp only
    45	  rw [dLineDescOf_ldDLineCL]
    46	  split_ifs with hdir hcoord hcoord
    47	  · exact le_rfl
    48	  · exfalso
    49	    apply hcoord
    50	    have hlast := congrFun hdir last
    51	    change prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed raw))
    52	      (LdSpace.direction raw) last = 0 at hlast
    53	    have hindex : ¬ last.val < (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed raw)).val := by
    54	      have := (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed raw)).isLt
    55	      dsimp [last]
    56	      omega
    57	    simpa [prefixProjection, hindex, LdSpace.direction, coord] using hlast
    58	  · norm_num
    59	  · exact le_rfl

    68	      if sample.1.direction = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤

    75	    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / Fintype.card (ScalarQ L)) :=

     7	This module transports directly indexed low-degree soundness at simultaneity
     8	parameter `1` from projective strategies to arbitrary strategies. Both local
     9	measurement families are dilated by the existing one-measurement Naimark
    10	construction. The polynomial-tuple POVMs returned by projective soundness are

     3	/-! # Ground-coordinate compression of finite measurements
     4	
     5	For a distinguished ancilla coordinate `k₀`, `groundCompressMeasurement k₀ M`
     6	has effects `M.effect a (i, k₀) (j, k₀)`. Positivity and completeness descend
     7	to this principal submatrix. Compression commutes with finite outcome
     8	postprocessing and preserves bipartite consistency exactly on `padState`.
     9	The two players' spaces and their ancilla spaces may all be different.
    10	
    11	These are Lean-only auxiliaries for the two Naimark steps in the proof of
    12	`lem:qld-4-7`, tracked by issue #277. They allow measurements on the enlarged
    13	spaces to be compared on the original spaces, including after polynomial
    14	evaluation. Compression does not in general preserve projectivity; obtaining
    15	projective measurements on the original spaces requires a separate rounding
    16	argument. No statement of `lem:qld-4-7` is formalized here.
    17	
    18	## References
    19	
    20	* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1278-1288`,
    21	  the two Naimark steps in the proof of `lem:qld-4-7`.
    22	* `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`,
    23	  `def:consistency`.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    27	
    28	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    29	open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.Quantum
    30	
    31	noncomputable section
    32	
    33	section Measurement
    34	
    35	variable {α β I K : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    36	  [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    37	
    38	/-- Compress every effect of a finite POVM to the coordinate `k₀` of its
    39	ancilla. This is the POVM with effects `J† M_a J`, where `J` inserts `k₀`.
    40	Positivity follows from `Matrix.PosSemidef.submatrix`, and completeness from
    41	the injectivity of the coordinate inclusion. -/
    42	def groundCompressMeasurement (k₀ : K) (M : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) :
    43	    Quantum.Measurement α I :=
    44	  Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    45	    (fun a => (M.effect a).submatrix (fun i => (i, k₀)) (fun i => (i, k₀)))
    46	    (fun a => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
    47	      ((Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (M.pos a)).submatrix _)) <| by
    48	    ext i j
    49	    simpa [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.one_apply] using
    50	      congrArg (fun T : Op (I × K) => T (i, k₀) (j, k₀)) M.sum_eq_one
    51	
    52	/-- The compressed effect is the principal submatrix at `k₀`. -/
    53	@[simp] theorem ground_compress_measurement_effect
    54	    (k₀ : K) (M : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) (a : α) (i j : I) :
    55	    (groundCompressMeasurement k₀ M).effect a i j =
    56	      M.effect a (i, k₀) (j, k₀) := rfl
    57	
    58	/-- Ground-coordinate compression commutes with arbitrary finite relabeling
    59	of outcomes, since taking a submatrix commutes with each fiber sum. -/
    60	@[simp] theorem ground_compress_measurement_postprocess
    61	    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    62	    (k₀ : K) (M : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) (f : α → β) :
    63	    groundCompressMeasurement k₀ (M.postprocess f) =
    64	      (groundCompressMeasurement k₀ M).postprocess f := by
    65	  apply Quantum.Measurement.ext
    66	  intro b
    67	  ext i j
    68	  simp only [ground_compress_measurement_effect, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    69	    Matrix.sum_apply]
    70	
    71	end Measurement

    73	section Bipartite
    74	
    75	variable {X α β I J K L : Type*}
    76	  [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    77	  [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    78	  [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L]
    79	
    80	/-- Every bipartite outcome correlation on the independently padded state
    81	equals the correlation of the compressed POVMs on the original state.
    82	Neither normalization nor equality of the player spaces is required. -/
    83	theorem vector_qform_ground_compress_measurement
    84	    (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
    85	    (A : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) (B : Quantum.Measurement β (J × L))
    86	    (a : α) (b : β) :
    87	    vectorQForm (padState k₀ l₀ ψ) (heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect b)) =
    88	      vectorQForm ψ (heteroKron
    89	        ((groundCompressMeasurement k₀ A).effect a)
    90	        ((groundCompressMeasurement l₀ B).effect b)) := by
    91	  exact stateQForm_padState k₀ l₀ ψ _ _ _ _ (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    92	
    93	/-- The averaged off-diagonal consistency defect is exactly preserved by
    94	ground-coordinate compression on independently padded bipartite states.
    95	This applies to any finite question distribution and any pair of POVM families. -/
    96	theorem consistency_defect_ground_compress_measurement [DecidableEq α]
    97	    (μ : Distribution X) (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
    98	    (A : X → Quantum.Measurement α (I × K))
    99	    (B : X → Quantum.Measurement α (J × L)) :
   100	    consistencyDefect μ
   101	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).effect a) 1)
   102	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((B x).effect a)) (padState k₀ l₀ ψ) =
   103	      consistencyDefect μ
   104	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((groundCompressMeasurement k₀ (A x)).effect a) 1)
   105	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((groundCompressMeasurement l₀ (B x)).effect a)) ψ := by
   106	  unfold consistencyDefect
   107	  apply avgOver_congr
   108	  intro x
   109	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   110	  intro a _
   111	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   112	  intro b _
   113	  split_ifs with hab
   114	  · rfl
   115	  · simp only [heteroKron_mul, mul_one, one_mul]
   116	    exact vector_qform_ground_compress_measurement k₀ l₀ ψ (A x) (B x) a b
   117	
   118	/-- A consistency bound holds on the independently padded state if and only
   119	if the same bound holds for the compressed measurements on the original state. -/
   120	theorem is_consistent_within_ground_compress_measurement_iff [DecidableEq α]
   121	    (μ : Distribution X) (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
   122	    (A : X → Quantum.Measurement α (I × K))
   123	    (B : X → Quantum.Measurement α (J × L)) (δ : ℝ) :
   124	    IsConsistentWithin μ
   125	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).effect a) 1)
   126	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((B x).effect a)) (padState k₀ l₀ ψ) δ ↔
   127	      IsConsistentWithin μ
   128	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((groundCompressMeasurement k₀ (A x)).effect a) 1)
   129	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((groundCompressMeasurement l₀ (B x)).effect a)) ψ δ := by
   130	  unfold IsConsistentWithin
   131	  rw [consistency_defect_ground_compress_measurement]
   132	
   133	/-- Exact consistency preservation also holds after question-dependent
   134	postprocessing. The original outcome types and the two outcome maps may
   135	differ; only the final outcome alphabet is shared. In the application to
   136	`lem:qld-4-7`, these maps include evaluation of the polynomial outcomes. -/
   137	theorem consistency_defect_ground_compress_measurement_postprocess
   138	    {γ : Type*} [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq γ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
   139	    (μ : Distribution X) (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
   140	    (A : X → Quantum.Measurement α (I × K))
   141	    (B : X → Quantum.Measurement β (J × L)) (f : X → α → γ) (g : X → β → γ) :
   142	    consistencyDefect μ
   143	        (fun x c => heteroKron (((A x).postprocess (f x)).effect c) 1)
   144	        (fun x c => heteroKron 1 (((B x).postprocess (g x)).effect c))
   145	        (padState k₀ l₀ ψ) =
   146	      consistencyDefect μ
   147	        (fun x c => heteroKron
   148	          (((groundCompressMeasurement k₀ (A x)).postprocess (f x)).effect c) 1)
   149	        (fun x c => heteroKron 1
   150	          (((groundCompressMeasurement l₀ (B x)).postprocess (g x)).effect c)) ψ := by
   151	  simpa only [ground_compress_measurement_postprocess] using
   152	    consistency_defect_ground_compress_measurement μ k₀ l₀ ψ
   153	      (fun x => (A x).postprocess (f x)) (fun x => (B x).postprocess (g x))
   154	
   155	end Bipartite
   156	
   157	/-- Compressing the existing completed Naimark dilation at `none` recovers
   158	the original POVM as a measurement, by its established effect identity. -/
   159	@[simp] theorem ground_compress_dilated_measurement
   160	    {α I : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   161	    (a₀ : α) (M : Quantum.Measurement α I) :
   162	    groundCompressMeasurement none (dilatedMeasurement a₀ M) = M := by
   163	  apply Quantum.Measurement.ext
   164	  intro a
   165	  ext i j
   166	  exact dilatedMeasurement_compression a₀ a M i j
